title: HR Intern
description:
HR INTERN – JOB DESCRIPTION

**Company:** ADA Tech Solution  
**Industry:** BPO / Business Process Outsourcing  
**Position:** HR Intern  
**Job Type:** Internship / Full\-Time Internship  
**Work Location:** Pune – Swargate  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office

About the Role

ADA Tech Solution is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated **HR Intern** to support our HR team in day\-to\-day HR operations and recruitment activities. This internship will provide practical exposure to **recruitment, employee engagement, onboarding, attendance, HR documentation, and other core HR functions** in a BPO environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist the HR team in **end\-to\-end recruitment activities**.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate calls.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates and interviewers.
* Maintain and update candidate and employee records.
* Assist with **joining formalities and onboarding documentation**.
* Support attendance and employee data management.
* Assist in preparing HR reports and maintaining HR trackers.
* Coordinate with employees regarding HR\-related queries.
* Support employee engagement activities and internal HR initiatives.
* Assist with exit formalities and documentation.
* Perform other HR\-related administrative tasks as assigned.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Pursuing or completed **MBA/PGDM in Human Resources**, BBA, B.Com, or any relevant discipline.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.
* Good interpersonal and coordination skills.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced BPO environment.
* Freshers and candidates looking for practical HR exposure are welcome.

What You Will Learn

* Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
* Interview Coordination
* Employee Onboarding
* HR Documentation
* Attendance \& Employee Data Management
* Employee Engagement
* HR Operations
* Basic Payroll \& Compliance Exposure
* BPO HR Processes

Preferred Candidate

**Immediate Joiners Preferred**

Benefits

* Practical exposure to HR operations
* Hands\-on recruitment experience
* Certificate / Internship experience
* Opportunity to learn HR processes in a BPO environment
* Potential opportunity for a full\-time role based on performance

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with the HR team.

**Email:** purwa29ada@gmail.com

description:
**HR Operations \& Talent Acquisition Specialist**

**About Hoola Health**

Parenting comes with questions, chaos, joy, and more than a few sleepless nights — and through it all, what every parent needs is a support system that just gets it.

**Hoola health** (formerly **babymd**) was created to be exactly that.

Our founder, Deeksha Senguttuvan, spent years working in healthcare and technology, but it was her close interactions with parents that revealed the real gap in paediatric care. Families were either navigating large hospitals with long waits and little personal connection, or relying on scattered, inconsistent care. There had to be a better way.

so in 2024, we began with one clinic and a simple mission: to make paediatric care feel closer, calmer, and kinder.

Today, hoola health is a growing network of neighbourhood clinics offering everything from consultations and vaccinations to developmental assessments and therapy services — all under one roof. We're proud to be open 7 days a week, backed by a team that listens first, treats with heart, and partners with parents every step of the way.

* Address employee queries related to HR policies, benefits, and processes.
* Assist in performance management, employee engagement, and training initiatives.
* Generate HR reports and maintain confidential employee information.

Required Qualifications

title: GM Service in chennai
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:\-

GENERAL MANAGER – SERVICE AT FPL GROUP

**Position**

General Manager – Service

**Company**

FPL GROUP

**Function**

After Sales – Service

**Location**

Chennai

**Team Size**

Multi\-location Service Operations

**Direct Reports**

Service Managers / Branch Heads, Workshop Managers, Parts Manager, CRM/Customer Experience Team, Body Shop / PDI Heads, as applicable

**Level**

Senior Management

The General Manager – Service will be responsible for the **overall leadership, business performance, profitability, customer experience and operational excellence of FPL GROUP after\-sales service operations across multiple locations**.

The incumbent will drive service revenue, gross profit, customer retention, workshop productivity, service quality and OEM compliance while ensuring consistent processes and customer experience across all FPL GROUP service outlets.

The role requires strong leadership of the complete after\-sales function, with a clear focus on **growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency and people development**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. BUSINESS \& FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE

* Own the overall service business plan, revenue, gross profit and profitability for FPL GROUP.
* Develop annual operating plans, budgets and monthly business targets.
* Drive achievement of labour, parts, value\-added service and total service revenue.
* Monitor branch\-wise financial performance and take corrective action.
* Improve workshop absorption, labour utilization, technician productivity and bay utilization.
* Control operating costs without compromising customer experience or service quality.
* Review branch\-wise P\&L, expenses, manpower productivity and profitability.
* Identify new revenue opportunities and develop initiatives for service business growth.
* Conduct regular business reviews with Service Managers and branch leadership teams.

MULTI\-LOCATION SERVICE OPERATIONS

* Provide overall leadership to FPL group multiple service locations.
* Establish uniform service processes, operating standards and performance benchmarks across branches.
* Ensure optimum utilization of workshop capacity, manpower, equipment and infrastructure.
* Monitor daily workshop loading, vehicle inflow, job\-card movement, WIP and delivery performance.
* Ensure adherence to promised delivery time and minimize vehicle turnaround time.
* Drive effective appointment planning, workshop loading and customer retention.
* Ensure proper management of warranty, recall, campaign, PDI and periodic maintenance activities.
* Implement best practices across locations and replicate successful initiatives.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE \& RETENTION

* Own overall customer satisfaction, CSI/NPS and customer retention performance.
* Establish a strong customer\-first culture across all service outlets.
* Monitor customer complaints, escalations and negative feedback.
* Personally intervene in critical customer issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Drive service retention through periodic maintenance, follow\-up and customer engagement programs.
* Improve repeat repair, comeback and complaint ratios.
* Review lost customers and develop corrective action plans.
* Ensure consistent customer experience from vehicle reception through delivery and follow\-up.

OEM PROCESS COMPLIANCE

* Ensure strict adherence to OEM policies, processes and operating standards.
* Monitor OEM KPIs, audits, service quality parameters and customer satisfaction benchmarks.
* Ensure implementation of OEM service standards across all locations.
* Maintain readiness for OEM audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with warranty, technical, service campaign and recall processes.
* Coordinate with OEM regional/zonal teams on business performance and operational matters.
* Implement OEM initiatives and ensure effective communication to all concerned teams.

WORKSHOP PRODUCTIVITY \& QUALITY

* Improve technician productivity, efficiency and utilization.
* Monitor first\-time\-fix rate and reduce repeat repairs/comebacks.
* Ensure effective diagnosis, repair quality and technical escalation management.
* Improve bay utilization and workshop throughput.
* Ensure proper use of special tools, diagnostic equipment and workshop infrastructure.
* Drive 5S, housekeeping, safety and process discipline.
* Monitor quality of vehicle delivery and ensure customer concerns are completely addressed.

PARTS \& SERVICE BUSINESS

* Work closely with Parts leadership to ensure adequate parts availability and optimum inventory.
* Improve parts\-to\-labour ratio and parts gross margin.
* Reduce parts ageing, obsolescence and stock\-outs.
* Ensure timely availability of fast\-moving and critical parts.
* Drive genuine parts usage and customer\-pay parts business.
* Identify opportunities for increasing accessory, AMC, extended warranty and other value\-added service revenue.

PEOPLE LEADERSHIP \& ORGANIZATION DEVELOPMENT

* Lead, mentor and develop Service Managers and the wider after\-sales leadership team.
* Set clear individual and departmental targets.
* Conduct monthly performance reviews and capability assessments.
* Identify manpower requirements based on business volume and productivity.
* Develop succession plans for key service positions.
* Build a high\-performance culture with strong accountability and ownership.
* Ensure technical and behavioural training for technicians, service advisors and managers.
* Improve employee engagement and reduce attrition in critical positions.

H. CUSTOMER \& BUSINESS ANALYTICS

* Establish a robust MIS and performance\-review mechanism.
* Review daily, weekly and monthly service KPIs.
* Analyze branch\-wise trends in:
* Vehicle inflow
* Revenue
* Gross profit
* Labour sales
* Parts sales
* Productivity
* Efficiency
* CSI/NPS
* Retention
* Repeat repair
* Vehicle turnaround time
* Use data\-driven analysis to identify gaps and implement corrective actions.

DIGITAL \& PROCESS IMPROVEMENT

* Promote digital service appointment and customer communication initiatives.
* Improve workshop appointment conversion and utilization.
* Encourage paperless/digital processes wherever applicable.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives across service operations.
* Benchmark FPL GROUP performance against leading Hyundai dealerships and industry best practices.

SAFETY, COMPLIANCE \& GOVERNANCE

* Ensure compliance with statutory, legal, environmental and safety requirements.
* Maintain high standards of workshop safety and housekeeping.
* Ensure proper handling of hazardous materials and workshop waste.
* Ensure proper documentation, audit readiness and process governance.
* Maintain discipline in financial controls, approvals and operational procedures.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS – KPI

The Service GM will be evaluated primarily on:

**Business**

* Service Revenue
* Gross Profit / Gross Margin
* P\&L Performance
* Labour Revenue
* Parts Revenue
* Revenue per RO / Vehicle

**Operations**

* Vehicle Inflow
* Workshop Productivity
* Technician Efficiency
* Technician Utilization
* Bay Utilization
* Vehicle Turnaround Time
* First\-Time Fix Rate
* Repeat Repair / Comeback %

**Customer**

* CSI / NPS
* Customer Retention
* Service Retention %
* Complaint Closure
* Customer Escalations
* Lost Customer Recovery

**People**

* Employee Productivity
* Training \& Certification
* Attrition
* Manpower Utilization
* Employee Engagement

**OEM / Process**

* OEM KPI Achievement
* OEM Audit Score
* Warranty Performance
* Campaign / Recall Completion
* Process Compliance

QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE

* Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Automobile, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent qualification.
* **12–18 years of experience in automobile after\-sales/service operations**.
* Minimum **5–8 years in a senior Service Manager / Regional Service Manager / GM\-Service / Head of Service role**.
* Experience managing **multiple service outlets or a large\-volume dealership operation** is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience in Hyundai or another leading passenger\-car OEM dealership environment.
* Proven track record in service revenue growth, profitability and customer satisfaction.
* Strong understanding of workshop operations, OEM processes, warranty, parts and service KPIs.
* Experience in managing large teams and multi\-location operations.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Strategic Leadership
* Business \& Commercial Acumen
* Multi\-Location Operations Management
* Customer\-Centric Leadership
* Financial Management
* Workshop \& Process Excellence
* People Development
* Performance Management
* Analytical \& Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Problem Solving
* Negotiation \& Influencing
* Change Management
* Communication Skills
* Integrity \& Accountability

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

The ideal candidate should be a **highly experienced automobile after\-sales leader** who can independently manage a large, multi\-location service business.

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to:

* Grow service revenue and profitability.
* Improve workshop productivity and operational efficiency.
* Deliver consistently high customer satisfaction.
* Lead and develop a large service organization.
* Manage multiple service locations through strong branch leadership.
* Work effectively with OEM teams and processes.
* Convert data and KPIs into measurable business improvements.

description:
Job description:

The Senior Store Officer will be responsible for managing and controlling all Store operations, including receipt, inspection, storage, inventory control, material issuance, stock verification, and documentation. The role requires ensuring the availability of materials while maintaining accurate inventory records and efficient Store operations.

Qualification

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.

Experience

* Minimum **7–8 years of experience** in Store Operations or Store Management.
* Experience in the **manufacturing sector** will be preferred.
* Experience in handling inventory management systems and ERP software is an advantage.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Inventory Management

* Receive incoming materials, equipment, and supplies and verify them against purchase orders, invoices, and delivery challans.
* Conduct inspection and ensure the quantity and condition of received materials are accurate.
* Maintain proper records of all inward and outward material movements.
* Ensure systematic storage, categorization, labelling, and identification of materials.
* Maintain accurate stock records using manual registers and/or ERP systems.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment of required materials.
* Conduct regular cycle counts and physical stock verification.
* Identify discrepancies in inventory and take necessary corrective action.
* Track material transfers and movement to and from the university.
* Monitor slow\-moving, non\-moving, damaged, and obsolete inventory.

2\. Store Operations

* Manage and supervise the day\-to\-day operations of the Store.
* Supervise Store staff and allocate daily responsibilities.
* Ensure timely issuance of materials to various departments.
* Maintain proper documentation for material receipt, issue, return, transfer, and disposal.
* Ensure safe handling, loading, unloading, and storage of materials.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and secure Store environment.
* Ensure compliance with established Store procedures and safety standards.

3\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of stock, material transactions, and inventory movements.
* Prepare periodic inventory and stock reports for management.
* Coordinate with the Purchase, Finance, Maintenance, and other concerned departments.
* Support internal and external audits by providing required inventory records and documentation.
* Ensure all Store\-related documents are properly maintained and filed.

4\. Team Management

* Guide and supervise Store Assistants and other Store staff.
* Ensure work is completed efficiently and within timelines.
* Monitor adherence to Store procedures and operational requirements.

Required Skills \& Competencies

* Knowledge of Store and Inventory Management.
* Experience in material handling and stock control.
* Knowledge of ERP and inventory management systems.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office.
* Knowledge of stock auditing and physical verification.
* Documentation and record management skills.
* Team supervision and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of safety procedures related to Store operations.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidate with 7–8 years of relevant Store Management experience.
* Experience in a manufacturing organization is preferred.
* Ability to manage inventory, Store operations, documentation, and staff independently.

description:
Key Responsibilities1\. Internal Audit Planning \& Execution

* Develop and execute risk\-based internal audit plans covering academic and non\-academic departments.
* Conduct audits of finance, admissions, examinations, procurement, HR, payroll, student services, hostel, transport, stores, and other university functions.
* Review processes, policies, controls, approvals, and supporting documentation.
* Perform transaction testing and verify compliance with approved policies and procedures.
* Identify control weaknesses, process gaps, financial irregularities, and operational risks.

2\. Academic \& University Process Audit

* Review academic processes including admissions, fee collection, scholarships, attendance, examinations, results, and student records.
* Audit compliance with University policies and applicable regulatory/statutory requirements.
* Review faculty\-related processes such as recruitment, workload, attendance, leaves, and academic documentation.
* Evaluate controls around research grants, projects, consultancy, and other academic activities where applicable.

3\. Financial \& Operational Audit

* Review financial transactions, expenditure, revenue, receivables, payments, and reconciliations.
* Examine procurement, vendor selection, purchase orders, contracts, inventory, and asset management processes.
* Review payroll, employee reimbursements, advances, and other employee\-related financial transactions.
* Assess operational efficiency and identify opportunities for cost optimization.

4\. Risk \& Compliance

* Identify and assess financial, operational, academic, and compliance risks.
* Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls.
* Monitor compliance with University policies, statutory requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Support management in developing risk mitigation and control improvement measures.

5\. Audit Reporting \& Follow\-up

* Prepare detailed internal audit reports highlighting observations, risks, root causes, and recommendations.
* Discuss audit findings with concerned department heads and obtain management responses.
* Maintain an audit observation tracker and monitor closure of corrective actions.
* Conduct follow\-up audits to verify implementation of agreed recommendations.
* Escalate significant or recurring control issues to senior management.

6\. Investigation \& Special Audits

* Conduct special audits and investigations as assigned by senior management.
* Review suspected financial irregularities, policy violations, process deviations, and control failures.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure proper documentation of audit evidence and findings.

7\. Team \& Stakeholder Management

* Lead and supervise internal audit team members.
* Allocate audit assignments and monitor completion within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with Finance, HR, Academics, Admissions, Procurement, Examination, IT, and other departments.
* Provide guidance and training to audit team members on audit procedures, risk assessment, and internal controls.

description:
**Position:** Talent Acquisition Specialist

**Company Name:** IBN Technologies Ltd.  
**Experience:** 3–4 Years  
**Location:** Pune  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Human Resources – Talent Acquisition

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented **End\-to\-End Recruiter** with 2–3 years of recruitment experience. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements to onboarding candidates. The candidate should have strong sourcing skills, excellent communication abilities, and experience hiring across technical and non\-technical roles.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle the complete recruitment lifecycle for assigned positions.
* Understand hiring requirements by coordinating with hiring managers.
* Prepare and post job descriptions on job portals, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, and other channels.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Schedule interviews and ensure a seamless candidate experience.
* Conduct salary negotiations and finalize compensation within the approved budget.
* Generate and roll out offer letters and follow up with candidates until joining.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, ATS, and candidate databases.
* Ensure timely closure of positions while maintaining quality of hires.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for future hiring needs.
* Coordinate with HR Operations for smooth onboarding and documentation.
* Prepare recruitment reports and provide regular hiring updates to management.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end recruitment process.
* Hands\-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing platforms.
* Experience in sourcing both technical and non\-technical profiles.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple positions simultaneously.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office, and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or any related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.

**About the Company:**

With over 26 years of industry experience, IBN Technologies is a trusted global outsourcing partner serving clients across the USA, UK, Middle East, and India. Operating from our advanced Global Delivery Center in Pune, We maintain the highest standards of quality and security through ISO 9001:2022 and ISO 27001:2022 certifications.

We specialize in driving digital and operational transformation through cybersecurity services, cloud solutions, finance \& accounting outsourcing, and customized middle\- and back\-office support for global enterprises and funds.

We look forward to speaking with you and discussing your potential contribution to our organization.

Workday Configuration \& Optimization

* Ensure alignment with business processes while maintaining system integrity and scalability
* Support audits, compliance requirements, and data integrity controls


Data, Reporting \& AI Enablement

* Partner with managed service teams for Visier and Druid AI on system updates, bug fixes and testing

Key Competencies


• Strong execution and delivery discipline with attention to detail• Ability to balance hands\-on configuration with team leadership

* Structured, process\-oriented mindset with a focus on scalability and efficiency
* Effective communicator across technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and innovation

Qualifications Required

* Background in process optimization, service delivery models, or managed services environments


Graduate/Higher degree

**Company Description** *In India, Bosch is a leading supplier of technology and services in the areas of Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. Additionally, Bosch has in India the largest development center outside Germany, for end\-to\-end engineering and technology solutions. The Bosch Group operates in India through twelve companies: Bosch Limited – the flagship company of the Bosch Group in India – Bosch Chassis Systems India Private Limited, Bosch Rexroth (India) Private Limited, Bosch Global Software Technologies, Bosch Automotive Electronics India Private Limited, Bosch Electrical Drives India Private Limited, BSH Home Appliances Private Limited, ETAS Automotive India Private Limited, Robert Bosch Automotive Steering Private Limited, Automobility Services and Solutions Private Limited, Newtech Filter India Private Limited and Mivin Engg.Technologies Private Limited. In India, Bosch set\-up its manufacturing operation in 1951, which has grown over the years to include 16 manufacturing sites, and seven development and application centers.*

  

  

**Job Description**  

The purpose of this position is to Head the Talent Acquisition \& Talent Attraction for Bosch Limited, in developing and executing strategies to attract Top Talent, build hiring strategies for Bosch as being a preferred employer among Talent fraternity.


1\. Overseeing recruitment processes, workload management for Talent Acquisition Managers, RPO, and Vendors to ensure effectiveness, leading to optimized hiring outcomes. Accountable for comprehensive end to end search to onboarding of new talent for RBIN


2\. Lead Ecosystem Development including Hiring manager coaching across RBIN such as UBCM, Talent Hub touchpoints and driving key new age practices in Industry


3\. Establish and monitor on recruiting processes, managing expectations of hiring managers and candidates, fostering excellence in key twin aspects of "Business Impact" \& "Candidate Experience" through agreed KPIs


4\. Formulate onboarding processes, strategies to engage through socialization, leading to a superior candidate experience, enhanced new joiner engagement and retention.


5\. Mentoring and developing a team across India, including TA Managers, RPO, and partners including Academia, to attract top talent


6\. Manage with RBIN ER \& Legal teams to ensure compliance with employment legislation, fostering strong stakeholder relationships, and aligning recruitment strategies with company objectives, resulting in efficient and legally compliant hiring processes.


7\. Monitor recruitment platforms, applying data\-driven approaches to achieve hiring goals efficiently, and ensuring compliance with diversity recruitment objectives, leading to a diverse and inclusive workforce.


8\. Developing and implementing Launch Pads for strategic talent attraction from academia, DEI Hiring and alternate models of attraction such as Veteran and Untapped markets, to sustain a talent pipeline, partnering with recruiting stakeholders to implement innovative recruitment campaigns, ensuring a continuous flow of qualified candidates.

 **Qualifications**  

Postgraduate (MBA/PGPM/PGDM) with specialization in HR


12\-15 years of deep HR professional know\-how and overall experience, with at least 5 \- 8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition.


Experience of working in a technology / manufacturing / engineering organization


Proficient knowledge of current HR trends, practices and Talent Acquisition market (both lateral and academia).


Competent knowledge on Pipeline hiring strategies \& Talent Attraction by outreach through identified social media platforms


Proficient collaboration and in\-depth business networking, interpersonal skills


Competent knowledge in consulting, problem\-solving, critical thinking, advisory, communication and analysis


Competent knowledge on Psychometric tools: Thomas PPA assessments, Hogan instruments


Radiate trust \& credibility with business including stakeholder management both internally (Hiring managers, Leadership) and externally (Consultants, Candidates, Academic Fraternity)

description:
**Human Resources (HR) Specialist / Generalist**

Job Overview

We are seeking a dynamic, highly knowledgeable, and results\-driven **HR Specialist** to take ownership of our human resources operations. This is not an entry\-level role; we require a professional with **at least 3 years of mandatory, hands\-on HR experience** who possesses deep, end\-to\-end expertise in the field. You will be responsible for managing the entire employee lifecycle, ensuring legal compliance, and fostering a high\-performance workplace culture.

Core Responsibilities

* **End\-to\-End Recruitment:** Manage the talent acquisition process, from sourcing and interviewing to negotiating offers and onboarding.
* **Employee Relations:** Serve as the primary point of contact for employee grievances, conflict resolution, and performance management.
* **Compliance \& Labour Laws:** Ensure all company policies, contracts, and workplace practices strictly align with current labour laws and statutory regulations.
* **Payroll \& Benefits Administration:** Oversee timely payroll processing, attendance tracking, leave management, and employee benefits.
* **Performance Evaluations:** Design and implement structured annual/quarterly performance review cycles.
* **HR Operations:** Maintain accurate digital employee records, draft HR policies, and manage offboarding/exit interviews.

**Requirements \& Qualifications (Mandatory)**

* **Experience:** **Minimum 5\+ years of continuous, verifiable experience** in a dedicated HR role (HR Generalist, HR Specialist, or HR Officer). *Applications with less than 3 years of experience will not be considered.*
* **Field Expertise:** Comprehensive, full\-spectrum knowledge of HR core functions, including recruitment strategies, employee engagement, and payroll systems.
* **Legal Knowledge:** Deep understanding of regional labor laws, employment standards, and compliance frameworks.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. (HR certification like SHRM or CIPD is a plus).
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in HRIS software (e.g., BambooHR, Workday, ZoHo People), ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems), and MS Office.
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional emotional intelligence, stellar conflict\-resolution skills, and absolute confidentiality.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: Up to ₹50,000\.00 per month

* Provident Fund

title: Onsite Recruitment Consultant
description:
\*About the Position\*

HyreSpot is looking for a proactive and energetic Field Recruiter to expand our candidate network and support our growing recruitment operations.

This is a field\-oriented recruitment position for someone who enjoys meeting people, developing contacts, identifying potential candidates, and converting hiring opportunities into successful joins.

The person in this role will work closely with the HR and Talent Acquisition team while independently exploring candidate sources such as local communities, colleges, training institutes, job fairs, referrals, job portals, and social media.

If you are confident speaking with people, enjoy networking, and are motivated by targets, this could be a good opportunity to build your career with HyreSpot.

\*Key Responsibilities\*

\* Identify and attract suitable candidates through field visits, referrals, online platforms, educational institutions, training centres, and local professional networks.

\* Meet candidates personally to understand their qualifications, experience, career interests, availability, and preferred job opportunities.

\* Conduct preliminary screening and shortlist candidates based on the requirements provided by the recruitment team.

\* Organize and participate in walk\-in interviews, recruitment campaigns, hiring drives, job fairs, and other talent acquisition activities.

\* Coordinate candidate interviews with the internal recruitment team and ensure candidates receive timely information about the process.

\* Maintain regular follow\-ups with shortlisted candidates and support them through documentation, selection, and joining.

\* Develop candidate networks within the assigned territory and continuously identify new sources for quality applicants.

\* Establish professional relationships with colleges, training institutes, placement centres, local organizations, and other talent pools.

\* Introduce candidates to HyreSpot's career opportunities and communicate job information clearly and professionally.

\* Assist the HR team in local employer\-branding and candidate\-engagement activities.

\* Monitor recruitment activity within the assigned area and identify effective methods for attracting candidates.

\* Share candidate feedback and local market information, including availability of talent and hiring trends, with the HR team.

\* Maintain accurate candidate details and ensure recruitment records are updated on time.

\* Submit daily and weekly activity reports covering sourcing, calls, meetings, interviews, selections, and joining status.

\* Work towards assigned recruitment targets and contribute to the team's overall hiring performance.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from:

\* Fresh graduates interested in building a career in recruitment or HR.

\* Candidates with up to 3 years of recruitment or talent acquisition experience.

\* Professionals from field sales, business development, customer service, telecalling, or other people\-oriented roles who want to move into recruitment.

Candidates with strong local networks and excellent communication skills.

A degree in any discipline is acceptable. An HR, Business Administration, or related qualification will be an added advantage.

\*What We Are Looking For\*

Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Confidence in approaching and speaking with new people.

Strong networking and relationship\-building ability.

Good follow\-up discipline.

A result\-oriented approach towards assigned targets.

Ability to manage recruitment activities independently.

Comfortable travelling within the assigned territory.

Basic knowledge of computers, email, spreadsheets, and online recruitment platforms.

Knowledge of the local language will be an advantage.

Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Experience That Will Help

Prior exposure to any of the following will be useful:

However, freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to work in the field are encouraged to apply.

Compensation \& Benefits

Salary: ₹16,000 – ₹24,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Additional Benefits:

Performance\-based recruitment incentives.

Travel allowance/reimbursement as per company policy.

Recruitment and talent acquisition training.

Practical exposure to multiple hiring channels.

Opportunity to develop a strong professional network.

Career progression opportunities within HR and Talent Acquisition.

Recognition for achieving recruitment and joining targets.

Career Opportunity

This role can provide a strong starting point for candidates who want to develop a long\-term career in Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Staffing, or Business Development.

High\-performing employees may be considered for increased responsibilities and future career progression within the organization based on performance, consistency, and business requirements.

Apply Now

If you enjoy meeting people, building connections, finding talent, and working towards measurable goals, HyreSpot would like to hear from you.

Join us and become part of a growing recruitment team focused on connecting candidates with meaningful career opportunities.

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹24,000\.00 per month

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

HyreSpot is looking for a proactive and energetic Field Recruiter to expand our candidate network and support our growing recruitment operations.

This is a field\-oriented recruitment position for someone who enjoys meeting people, developing contacts, identifying potential candidates, and converting hiring opportunities into successful joins.

The person in this role will work closely with the HR and Talent Acquisition team while independently exploring candidate sources such as local communities, colleges, training institutes, job fairs, referrals, job portals, and social media.

\* Maintain accurate candidate details and ensure recruitment records are updated on time.

\* Submit daily and weekly activity reports covering sourcing, calls, meetings, interviews, selections, and joining status.

\* Work towards assigned recruitment targets and contribute to the team's overall hiring performance.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from:

\* Fresh graduates interested in building a career in recruitment or HR.

Confidence in approaching and speaking with new people.

Strong networking and relationship\-building ability.

Good follow\-up discipline.

A result\-oriented approach towards assigned targets.

Ability to manage recruitment activities independently.

Comfortable travelling within the assigned territory.

Basic knowledge of computers, email, spreadsheets, and online recruitment platforms.

Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

However, freshers with the right attitude, communication skills, and willingness to work in the field are encouraged to apply.

Salary: ₹16,000 – ₹24,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and interview performance.

Performance\-based recruitment incentives.

Travel allowance/reimbursement as per company policy.

Recruitment and talent acquisition training.

Practical exposure to multiple hiring channels.

Career progression opportunities within HR and Talent Acquisition.

Recognition for achieving recruitment and joining targets.

**Stipend:** ₹7,000 per month \+ Travel Allowance

* Meet business owners, managers, and key decision\-makers.
* Understand the client's existing workflow, challenges, and requirements.
* Explain and demonstrate the SaaS product, including its features, benefits, and business value.
* Conduct product demonstrations and presentations at client locations.
* Generate leads through **field outreach, cold outreach, referrals, networking, and direct prospecting**.
* Regularly follow up with interested prospects and work towards converting them into customers.
* Handle the business development cycle from **prospecting → client visit → product demo → follow\-up → conversion → onboarding**.
* Maintain proper records of leads, client meetings, follow\-ups, feedback, and conversions.
* Collect market and customer feedback and communicate insights to the internal product and management teams.
* Attend relevant networking events, exhibitions, industry events, and business meetups when required.

Field Work \& Travel

This is **not a remote or work\-from\-home internship**.

The intern will primarily be working **on the field between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM**, visiting prospective clients and conducting meetings and product demonstrations.

Candidates must be comfortable with:

* Travelling regularly to different client locations.
* Meeting and interacting with new people every day.
* Conducting face\-to\-face sales conversations.
* Demonstrating the product at client locations.
* Planning daily client visits and follow\-ups.
* Working independently while on the field.

**Official travel expenses for assigned client visits will be covered through a Travel Allowance in addition to the ₹7,000 monthly stipend.**

Skills \& Requirements

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

* Good presentation, negotiation, and convincing skills.

* Ability to understand a SaaS product and explain it in simple business terms.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable with field\-based work.
* Willingness to travel regularly for client meetings.
* Basic knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets or CRM tools is an advantage.
* Freshers and final\-year students interested in building a career in **Business Development and SaaS Sales** can apply.

Career Opportunity

The first **3 months will serve as an internship and performance evaluation period**.

Candidates who demonstrate strong performance in **client outreach, meetings, product demonstrations, lead generation, follow\-ups, conversions, communication, and overall ownership** will be considered for conversion into a **full\-time Business Development Executive role**.

We are looking for someone who enjoys being **on the ground, meeting clients, understanding their problems, presenting solutions, and actively contributing to business growth.**

About Meritzee

Meritzee is an EdTech company building a tutor/learning app that connects students with quality educators and courses. We are looking for driven, target\-oriented Sales Executives who can generate leads, run engaging webinars, and close admissions/sales through both tele\-calling and field visits.

Role Summary

The Sales Executive will be responsible for the end\-to\-end sales cycle — from lead generation and cold calling to conducting webinars/demo sessions, handling field sales visits, and closing enrollments/subscriptions for the Meritzee tutor app.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Lead Generation \& Prospecting**

**4\. Sales Conversion \& Closing**

* Achieve individual and team sales/revenue targets on a weekly/monthly basis.

description:

**Work Mode During Probation:** Remote  
**Work Mode After Confirmation:** Hybrid  
**Compensation During Probation:** Incentive\-Based  
**Experience:** Freshers \& Experienced Candidates Can Apply

About the Role

Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for motivated, responsible, and performance\-oriented HR professionals to join our growing Human Resources team.

The selected candidate will receive exposure to multiple HR functions, including **Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Management, Candidate Handling, HRMS, Performance Management, Training \& Development, HR Administration, Vendor Management, and HR Reporting**.

The candidate will initially join the **HR Department**, and the final designation/profile will be determined after successful completion of the probation period based on performance, skills, responsibilities handled, leadership potential, and organizational requirements.

Potential Profiles After Probation

Depending on performance and suitability, the final designation may include:

* HR Recruiter
* HR Executive
* Senior HR Executive
* Talent Acquisition Executive
* HR Operations Executive
* Vendor Management Executive
* HR Manager
* Other suitable HR\-related positions

Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment activities.
* Understand manpower requirements and job descriptions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, social media, referrals, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes according to job requirements.
* Conduct initial telephonic/video screening interviews.
* Evaluate candidate communication, experience, skills, availability, salary expectations, and suitability.
* Shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule and coordinate interviews.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with candidates.
* Collect interview feedback and update candidate status.
* Coordinate with selected candidates until successful joining.
* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers.
* Work toward improving candidate joining and retention ratios.

2\. Candidate Handling

* Communicate job requirements clearly to candidates.
* Verify candidate interest and consent before profile submission.
* Explain job role, location, work mode, salary structure, interview process, and joining requirements accurately.
* Maintain professional communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Follow up before and after interviews.
* Handle candidate queries professionally.
* Reduce interview no\-shows and joining dropouts.
* Maintain accurate candidate status and communication records.
* Avoid false commitments or unauthorized promises to candidates.

3\. HR Operations

* Support day\-to\-day HR operations.
* Maintain employee records and HR databases.
* Manage HR documentation and administrative processes.
* Coordinate internal HR activities.
* Prepare and maintain HR reports.
* Support implementation of company HR policies and procedures.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and organizational information.

4\. Employee Onboarding

* Coordinate pre\-joining and joining formalities.
* Collect and verify employee documents.
* Maintain employee onboarding records.
* Coordinate induction and orientation.
* Explain company policies, procedures, attendance rules, and work expectations.
* Support HRMS/account creation.
* Assist new employees during their initial employment period.

5\. Employee Management \& Relations

* Maintain professional relationships with employees.
* Address routine employee queries.
* Coordinate employee concerns and grievances with management.
* Support conflict resolution.
* Maintain proper documentation of employee\-related matters.
* Promote professional workplace communication and discipline.

6\. Attendance, Leave \& HRMS

* Monitor employee attendance and working status.
* Maintain attendance and leave records.
* Coordinate leave applications and approvals.
* Monitor late logins, early logouts, absenteeism, and attendance irregularities.
* Maintain accurate employee information in HRMS.
* Monitor login/logout and employee work status where applicable.
* Prepare attendance and leave reports for management.

7\. Performance Management

* Monitor employee performance during probation and employment.
* Track assigned tasks, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Maintain performance records.
* Identify performance gaps.
* Coordinate performance reviews.
* Support performance improvement initiatives.
* Provide accurate performance information to management for confirmation, extension, promotion, or other employment decisions.

8\. Training \& Development

* Identify employee training requirements.
* Coordinate employee induction and training programs.
* Maintain training attendance and records.
* Monitor participation in mandatory training.
* Collect training feedback.
* Support employee skill\-development initiatives.

9\. Vendor Management

* Identify potential recruitment and staffing vendors.
* Communicate with recruitment agencies and consultancy partners.
* Build and maintain professional vendor relationships.
* Share approved manpower requirements and job descriptions with vendors.
* Receive and review candidate profiles submitted by vendors.
* Check candidate quality, eligibility, and relevance.
* Coordinate vendor\-submitted candidate interviews.
* Follow up with vendors for candidate status and interview feedback.
* Track candidates from profile submission through joining.
* Maintain vendor databases and trackers.
* Monitor vendor performance and candidate quality.
* Coordinate pending requirements and recruitment closures.
* Support vendor onboarding and documentation.
* Support commercial discussions and negotiations when authorized by management.
* Ensure vendors follow approved company processes and commercial terms.
* Identify and develop new recruitment/vendor partnerships.
* Escalate vendor\-related issues to management.

10\. HR Documentation \& Administration

* Maintain employee files and records.
* Prepare or support preparation of HR letters and documents.
* Maintain joining, onboarding, probation, and performance records.
* Maintain disciplinary documentation where applicable.
* Ensure confidential documents are properly maintained.
* Support payroll\-related documentation and attendance inputs when authorized.

11\. HR Reporting \& MIS

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR reports.
* Maintain recruitment and candidate pipeline reports.
* Prepare employee attendance and status reports.
* Maintain joining and attrition records.
* Prepare vendor performance reports.
* Ensure HR data submitted to management is accurate and updated.

12\. Employee Engagement

* Support employee engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate internal meetings and HR activities.
* Support employee recognition programs.
* Collect employee feedback.
* Help maintain positive internal communication and workplace engagement.

13\. Exit Management

* Coordinate resignation and exit formalities.
* Maintain resignation and relieving records.
* Support exit interviews.
* Coordinate departmental clearance.
* Support Full \& Final documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee exit records.

Required Skills

Candidates should possess or be willing to develop:

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Recruitment and candidate\-handling ability.
* Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of Human Resources.
* Candidate sourcing and screening skills.
* Employee\-handling ability.
* Vendor\-management and negotiation skills.
* Documentation and reporting skills.
* HRMS and basic computer proficiency.
* MS Excel/Google Sheets knowledge.
* Time\-management and multitasking ability.
* Problem\-solving skills.
* Team coordination and leadership potential.
* Professionalism and confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Candidate Eligibility

* Graduate or pursuing graduation in HR, Management, Business Administration, or a relevant field.
* MBA/BBA/B.Com or HR\-related qualifications may be preferred but are not mandatory for all profiles.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and willingness to learn may apply.
* Experienced candidates with recruitment, HR operations, consultancy, staffing, or vendor\-management experience are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates should have access to a laptop/desktop and a stable internet connection for remote work.

Probation \& Final Designation

The initial probation period will be **2 months**.

During probation, candidates will be evaluated on:

* Recruitment performance
* Candidate sourcing and quality
* Candidate handling
* HR operations
* Employee management
* Vendor management
* Communication skills
* Attendance and discipline
* Documentation and reporting accuracy
* Task completion
* Problem\-solving ability
* Team coordination
* Leadership potential
* Professional conduct
* Overall contribution to the organization

Following successful completion of probation, **management will determine the candidate's final designation/profile based on demonstrated performance, capabilities, responsibilities handled, organizational requirements, and overall suitability.**

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is suitable for candidates who:

* Want to build a long\-term career in Human Resources.
* Are interested in both recruitment and core HR operations.
* Want practical exposure to employee and vendor management.
* Are comfortable communicating with candidates, employees, vendors, and management.
* Are disciplined, responsible, and performance\-oriented.
* Can take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
* Are willing to learn multiple areas of HR rather than limiting themselves to recruitment only.

**Join Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and gain hands\-on exposure across Recruitment, HR Operations, Employee Management, HRMS, Performance Management, and Vendor Management.**

title: Transition Manager
description:
1\. JOB PURPOSE

The Transition Manager will be responsible for **end\-to\-end transition and mobilization of new Facility Management contracts**, from contract award until successful operational stabilization and handover to the Operations team.

The role will act as the **single point of accountability for transition**, coordinating with Sales, Operations, HR, Recruitment, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, QHSE, IT and client stakeholders to ensure projects go live **on time, within approved budget and with zero major service disruption**.

The candidate should have strong experience in **manpower mobilization, soft services, hard services, commercial planning, statutory compliance, vendor management, client handling and project implementation**.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Transition \& Mobilization

* Lead end\-to\-end transition of newly awarded FM / IFM contracts.
* Prepare detailed **30/60/90\-day transition and mobilization plans**.
* Conduct site surveys and understand client requirements, scope of work and operational expectations.
* Review contract, SLA, KPI, manpower deployment and commercial requirements before mobilization.
* Develop project\-wise mobilization schedules, milestones and responsibility matrices.
* Ensure timely readiness of manpower, supervisors, equipment, machinery, consumables, uniforms, PPE and other resources.
* Ensure smooth transition from incumbent service provider to the new FM service provider.
* Identify transition risks and develop contingency and mitigation plans.
* Ensure **zero critical operational disruption during go\-live**.

B. Manpower Planning \& Recruitment

* Prepare manpower deployment plans based on contract requirements and approved budgets.
* Coordinate with HR and Recruitment teams for timely hiring and onboarding.
* Plan local and outstation manpower mobilization wherever required.
* Ensure deployment of qualified supervisors, engineers and operational teams.
* Coordinate employee documentation, background verification, medical fitness, training and induction.
* Monitor manpower readiness against the project mobilization timeline.
* Ensure replacement plans are available for critical positions.

C. Client \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary transition SPOC for the client.
* Conduct transition kick\-off meetings with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Establish regular transition review meetings and governance mechanisms.
* Understand client expectations and convert them into operational requirements.
* Manage client escalations during the mobilization phase.
* Coordinate with incumbent vendors / client representatives for smooth handover.
* Present transition progress, risks, issues and action plans to senior management.

D. Commercial \& Budget Management

* Review approved commercial proposals and transition budgets.
* Ensure mobilization activities are executed within the approved budget.
* Monitor manpower cost, equipment cost, consumables, uniforms, PPE and other startup expenses.
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations to ensure project profitability.
* Identify cost\-saving opportunities without compromising service quality.
* Monitor deviations between **approved budget vs. actual transition cost**.
* Support Operations in understanding contract commercials, billing parameters and SLA requirements.
* Identify opportunities for additional services / upselling during transition.

E. Operations Readiness

* Ensure all operational SOPs, checklists, formats and escalation matrices are ready before go\-live.
* Establish site organization structure and reporting hierarchy.
* Ensure deployment of supervisors and key management personnel.
* Ensure equipment, machinery and consumables are available before commencement.
* Coordinate with Operations for service\-specific readiness.
* Establish daily, weekly and monthly reporting mechanisms.
* Conduct operational readiness audits before handover.

F. Soft Services

Experience / understanding in:

* Housekeeping
* Security
* Pantry / Food Services
* Pest Control
* Landscaping
* Waste Management
* Helpdesk / Front Office
* Support Services

Ensure manpower, SOPs, equipment, consumables and service standards are aligned with contractual requirements.

G. Hard Services / Technical Services

Should have good understanding of FM engineering services such as:

* Electrical
* HVAC
* DG / UPS
* Plumbing
* STP / WTP
* Fire \& Life Safety
* BMS
* Civil Maintenance
* Preventive \& Breakdown Maintenance
* AMC / Vendor Management

Technical engineering expertise is particularly relevant for senior FM transition roles handling integrated technical operations.

H. Compliance \& QHSE

* Ensure statutory and client compliance requirements are completed before go\-live.
* Coordinate with HR / Compliance teams for PF, ESI, labour law and other applicable requirements.
* Ensure safety documentation and risk assessments are completed.
* Ensure required licenses, certificates and statutory records are available.
* Coordinate QHSE audits and pre\-start inspections.
* Ensure 100% compliance with client and company safety standards.

I. Procurement \& Vendor Management

* Identify mobilization requirements and initiate procurement activities.
* Coordinate with Procurement for timely delivery of equipment, machinery and consumables.
* Finalize / onboard approved vendors as per company process.
* Monitor vendor delivery timelines and quality.
* Ensure AMC / service contracts are established wherever required.
* Maintain vendor performance and escalation records.

J. Technology \& MIS

* Drive implementation of CAFM / CMMS / HRMS / Helpdesk systems at new sites.
* Ensure employee and asset master data is created before go\-live.
* Implement attendance, payroll and workforce management processes.
* Establish dashboards and transition MIS.
* Track manpower, cost, SLA, compliance and mobilization status.
* Use **MS Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI / MIS tools** for management reporting.

K. Handover \& Stabilization

* Conduct final operational readiness review before go\-live.
* Prepare detailed handover checklist for Operations.
* Ensure all documents, asset details, manpower data, SOPs and vendor information are handed over.
* Conduct knowledge\-transfer sessions with the Operations team.
* Monitor the account during the initial **30–90 days stabilization period**.
* Track transition issues until closure.

title: AI Engineer (Fresher)
description:
##### **LOCATION**
**Mumbai/Pune**

##### **EXPERIENCE**
**0 \- 1 years**

##### **FUNCTIONAL AREA**
**Development**

**Role Overview**



As an AI Engineer, you’ll be part of a next\-generation engineering team building intelligent, autonomous systems that combine Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic reasoning frameworks. You’ll participate end\-to\-end — from data ingestion and model training to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, and deployment of scalable microservices. This role demands curiosity, precision, and a passion for bridging traditional ML and modern LLM\-based agentic architectures into production\-grade systems.



Key Responsibilities


* Design and implement RAG pipelines for large\-scale data retrieval and contextual reasoning.


* Build, train, and fine\-tune ML models using Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch for structured and unstructured datasets.


* Develop modular AI microservices (FastAPI/Flask) integrated with vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Elasticsearch) and embedding pipelines.


* Orchestrate multi\-agent systems using LangGraph, LangChain, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) for dynamic task execution.


* Integrate and evaluate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Groq, Anthropic, etc.) for reasoning, generation, and workflow automation.


* Implement data and ML pipelines (Airflow, ZenML, Dagster) for training, evaluation, and inference.


* Develop and expose REST or WebSocket APIs for model and agent communication.


* Apply prompt engineering and reranking strategies to improve contextual accuracy and system reasoning.


* Work closely with data, backend, and AI engineers to deploy, scale, and monitor intelligent microservices in test/staging environments.


* Contribute to shared AI infrastructure modules, ensuring reproducibility, maintainability, and performance.


* Research and prototype new architectures, including multimodal RAG, structured reasoning, or fine\-tuning pipelines.



Required Technical Skills


* Strong understanding of RAG architecture — document chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and synthesis.


* Proficiency in Python, including libraries like Pandas, Numpy, and Scikit\-learn.


* Experience with FastAPI or Flask for microservice and API development.


* Hands\-on with LangGraph, LangChain, or MCP for multi\-agent orchestration.


* Familiarity with vector databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Elasticsearch).


* Good Working knowledge of ML/DL frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).


* Understanding of model serving via REST APIs, batch jobs, or pipelines.


* Exposure to containerization (Docker) and scalable architecture patterns.


* Familiarity with Git, MLflow, or DVC for versioning, tracking, and collaboration.


* Awareness of cloud AI/ML services (Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI).


* Understanding of prompt evaluation, retrieval accuracy metrics, and contextual reasoning benchmarks.


**Secondary Skills**
--------------------


* Curiosity to explore Agentic AI frameworks and autonomous reasoning systems.


* Analytical mindset with a focus on debugging, optimization, and scalability.


* Strong communication and documentation skills for collaborative workflows.


* Innovative and research\-driven approach toward new AI architectures.

title: HR Associate
description:
#### **Job Overview**


We are looking for a smart and energetic HR Associate to be a part of our Human Resources department. You will be primarily responsible for actively assisting in the entire recruitment process. Besides, you should also be able to assist existing employees with any of their queries.


As an HR Associate, you should be able to contact and communicate with potential candidates by phone or email. Moreover, you should also be able to cross\-check candidate details and gather all important documents. Furthermore, you should ensure abiding to the legal guidelines at all times.


To be able to perform in this job role, you should have complete knowledge of best human resources practices and familiarity with various ATS. In addition to this, you should be empathetic and demonstrate good decision\-making skills. Your ability to work independently and collaboratively will be an added advantage.


Get in touch with us if you can fulfil the job responsibilities. We would love to have a word with you.


#### **Responsibilities**

* Update our internal databases with new employee data, including contact details and employment forms.
* Assist in screening forms and resumes of applicants.
* Plan and schedule interviews with candidates.
* Manage job advertisements on job portals and social networks.
* Create reports on the HR\-related process when required.
* Contacting and communicating with potential candidates
* Reviewing candidate resumes and other important details
* Communicating with candidate references to verify candidate details
* Creating, maintaining, and updating potential candidates and employee records
* Drafting and sending employee contracts
* Guiding the candidates in completing all the necessary recruiting formalities
* Collecting and maintaining all candidate and employee documents
* Ensuring that the candidates are informed about the employee benefits and any other details
* Leave and payroll assistance
* Coordinating day\-to\-day activities with the stakeholders.

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Management, or a related field
* Fresher to 1 year of work experience as an HR Associate, HR Coordinator or a similar role in the Human Resources department
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management or a similar field
* Experience working as an HR intern or a similar role in the Human Resources Department would be an added advantage.
* Familiar with the recruiting process.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong work ethic.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Having an eye for detail
* Highly motivated and reliable individual
* Displaying a welcoming personality.



Note: CTC 1\.60 to 2\.40 LPA

title: MARKETING / BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT INTERN
description:
MARKETING / BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT INTERN

**Company:** V Support Solutions  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Internship Duration:** 2–3 Months  
**Department:** Marketing / Business Development  
**Position Type:** Internship

About the Role

V Support Solutions is looking for a Marketing / Business Development Intern to support client research, lead generation, business outreach, recruitment\-service promotion and relationship\-building activities.

The intern will work closely with the recruitment and business teams and gain practical exposure to how an HR and recruitment company develops business opportunities and connects with organizations that require hiring support.

Key Responsibilities

* Research companies, industries and potential business prospects.
* Identify organizations that may have recruitment or HR outsourcing requirements.
* Build and maintain prospect databases using online research and business platforms.
* Support lead generation through LinkedIn, websites, directories, social media and other channels.
* Assist with initial business outreach through email, phone and professional networking channels.
* Prepare and customize introductory messages based on prospect requirements.
* Understand client hiring requirements and coordinate relevant information with the recruitment team.
* Assist in presenting V Support Solutions' recruitment and HR services to prospective clients.
* Follow up with prospects and maintain regular communication.
* Maintain lead trackers, outreach records and business development MIS.
* Research competitors, market opportunities and potential sectors for business development.
* Support recruitment campaigns and promotional activities that generate candidate and client leads.
* Assist in preparing marketing materials, presentations and business communication.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead\-generation and outreach processes.

Skills Required

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in speaking with new people.
* Basic knowledge of sales, marketing or business development.
* Good internet research skills.
* Ability to write professional emails and messages.
* Basic Excel / Google Sheets knowledge.
* Persistence and willingness to follow up.
* Ability to understand business requirements and communicate them clearly.

Learning Exposure

The intern will gain practical experience in:

* Lead generation
* B2B marketing
* Business research
* Cold outreach
* Client communication
* Recruitment\-service marketing
* Prospect management
* Follow\-up systems
* CRM/MIS management
* Business development strategy

Ideal Candidate

Students or fresh graduates from MBA, BBA, BBM, Marketing, Commerce, Management or any relevant discipline who are interested in Marketing, Sales, Business Development or B2B recruitment services.

Stipend

**Performance\-Based Stipend:** ₹6,000 – ₹24,000 per month, based on performance and internship contribution.

The stipend structure will be discussed during the selection process and will depend on the intern’s performance, productivity, and overall contribution during the internship.

Pay: ₹6,000\.00 \- ₹24,000\.00 per month

* Analyse recruitment activity and basic metrics such as sourcing volume, screening, interviews, selections and joining status.
* Assist in preparing and publishing attractive job advertisements.
* Support recruitment campaigns through LinkedIn, WhatsApp and other digital channels.
* Coordinate with internal team members regarding urgent and priority requirements.
* Maintain professional communication with candidates and client representatives.
* Conduct online research for talent mapping, competitor hiring and potential candidate sources.

* Good Tamil and English communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and candidate\-handling skills.
* Confidence in making recruitment calls.
* Good internet and profile\-searching skills.
* Ability to understand and analyse job descriptions.
* Basic resume screening knowledge.
* Good follow\-up discipline.
* Basic Excel / Google Sheets knowledge.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously.
* Willingness to learn recruitment processes and work with targets.

Preferred Candidates

* MBA / PGDM – HR or Marketing
* MSW / HR specialization
* BBA / BBM / Any Degree with strong interest in HR and recruitment
* Final\-year students and fresh graduates may apply.

* Resume screening
* Telephonic screening

* Quality and quantity of candidate sourcing

* Communication skills
* Candidate follow\-up

* Ability to understand job requirements
* Teamwork and learning ability

Computech Engineers is a system integrator with over 25 years of expertise in computer networking and IT infrastructure. As a Premier Cisco Partner, we design and deploy reliable, scalable solutions across enterprise environments, including research labs, educational institutions, and large corporate campuses.

This is an execution\-focused HR and recruitment role covering hiring, internship management, employee administration and basic HR systems.

You will be responsible for coordinating recruitment requirements and taking roles from sourcing through to joining, while keeping day\-to\-day HR processes organised.

Hiring \& Talent Acquisition

* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, referrals and direct outreach.
* Screen candidates and maintain structured recruitment pipelines.
* Recruit for Sales, Pre\-Sales and IT/networking roles, as well as interns and freelancers.

* Understand basic IT and networking terminology when screening technical candidates.
* Coordinate interviews, candidate communication and follow\-ups.
* Work with IT recruitment agencies and technical training/placement institutes to source candidates.
* Own internship hiring, including sourcing through job boards, colleges and referrals.

* Prepare and send offer letters, NDAs and employment documents.
* Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Track employee records, probation, leave and attendance.
* Maintain organised HR systems using Google Sheets, Google Drive and Notion.
* Follow up with team members for required updates, documentation and logs.
* Help establish and improve basic HR processes as the company grows.

KPIs

* Roles closed as per requirement.
* Time taken to close roles.
* Candidate drop\-off rate.
* Quality and relevance of shortlisted candidates.
* No missed follow\-ups or tracking gaps.
* Accuracy and completeness of employee records.

REQUIREMENTS

* Bachelor's degree required; proof of degree completion will be required.
* 2\+ years of HR/recruitment experience preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with Naukri, LinkedIn and Indeed.
* Experience recruiting Sales and Pre\-Sales candidates.
* Familiarity with IT/networking recruitment.
* Experience working with IT recruitment agencies or technical training/placement institutes is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Good follow\-up and organisational skills.
* Comfortable with Google Sheets and Google Drive; Notion is a plus.

WORK LOCATION

description:
**About NSFI**

National Skills Foundation of India (NSFI) is committed to strengthening skills, livelihoods, and development initiatives through effective programme implementation and institutional partnerships. The organization works closely with internal teams, partners, consultants, and other stakeholders to ensure efficient delivery of its programmes and operations.

**Position Summary**

The Admin and HR Associate will be responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day human resource and administrative functions of NSFI. The position will ensure smooth office operations, proper maintenance of employee and organizational records, timely coordination of HR processes, and effective administrative support to the organization and its projects.

The role requires a well\-organized, responsible, and proactive individual who can manage multiple tasks, maintain confidentiality, and coordinate effectively with employees, consultants, vendors, and management.

**Key ResponsibilitiesA. Human Resource Management**

* Support the recruitment process, including posting job vacancies, screening applications, scheduling interviews, and coordinating with candidates.
* Assist in employee onboarding and induction processes.
* Prepare and maintain employee documentation, including appointment letters, contracts, consultant agreements, and other HR\-related documents.
* Maintain and regularly update employee records and personnel files.
* Monitor employee attendance, leave records, and other HR\-related information.
* Coordinate the collection and verification of monthly timesheets and other required employee documentation.
* Support the preparation and coordination of payroll\-related inputs, reimbursements, allowances, and other employee payments.
* Assist in managing employee exits, including documentation, handover processes, and clearance procedures.
* Maintain an updated database of employees, consultants, interns, and other human resources associated with NSFI.
* Support the implementation of HR policies, procedures, and organizational guidelines.
* Ensure confidentiality and proper handling of employee information and sensitive documents.

**B. Administration and Office Management**

* Ensure the smooth day\-to\-day functioning of the office.
* Maintain office records, files, registers, and administrative documentation in both physical and digital formats.
* Coordinate office supplies, stationery, equipment, and other administrative requirements.
* Maintain an inventory of office assets and ensure proper documentation of asset allocation and movement.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for office\-related requirements.
* Support procurement and purchase processes as per organizational procedures.
* Assist in obtaining quotations, preparing comparative statements, and maintaining procurement\-related documentation.
* Coordinate office maintenance, repairs, and other facility\-related requirements.
* Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence, couriers, and official documents.
* Support the organization and logistics of meetings, workshops, training programmes, and events.
* Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodation, and other logistical requirements for employees and consultants, as required.

**C. Documentation and Compliance Support**

* Maintain proper records of administrative and HR\-related documents.
* Support the preparation and maintenance of organizational policies, formats, and standard operating procedures.
* Ensure that employee and administrative documentation is complete and properly filed.
* Support the Operations and Finance teams in collecting and maintaining required documents for audits and compliance purposes.
* Maintain trackers for HR, administration, assets, contracts, and other operational requirements.
* Ensure timely follow\-up on pending documentation and approvals.

**D. Operational Coordination**

* Coordinate with project teams to support their administrative and HR\-related requirements.
* Follow up with employees, consultants, and relevant stakeholders for timely submission of required documents.
* Support management in implementing organizational systems and processes.
* Assist in preparing periodic administrative and HR reports and updates.
* Perform other responsibilities assigned by the management based on organizational requirements.

**Qualifications and ExperienceEssential Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, Commerce, or a related field.
* A postgraduate qualification in HR or Management will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* 0–3 years of relevant experience in HR, administration, office management, or operations.
* Experience working with an NGO, development organization, social sector organization, or project\-based organization will be preferred.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Good understanding of basic HR and administrative processes.
* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
* Good documentation and record\-management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
* Attention to detail and ability to follow established processes.
* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly.
* Proactive approach and willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

**Key Competencies**

* Integrity and confidentiality
* Attention to detail
* Planning and organization
* Coordination and follow\-up
* Problem\-solving
* Accountability
* Teamwork
* Adaptability
* Professional communication

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a responsible and proactive professional who can support NSFI in strengthening its internal HR and administrative systems. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a dynamic environment, coordinating with multiple teams and stakeholders, and ensuring that routine processes and documentation are completed accurately and on time.

**NSFI is an equal opportunity employer and encourages qualified candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply.**

At Dormer Pramet IT is positioned as a trusted technology partner and efficient service provider to the business. The **SAP Competence Center****Manager** holds a critical role in ensuring that both the functional and technical solutions within our ERP platform align with high\-level enterprise architecture and meet business requirements, facilitating smooth business operations.


About the role


This Managerial Role is part of IT Management Team.


As **SAP Competence Center****Manager**, you report to ITVP directly and work closely with BPO team, delivering insightful analysis and action\-focused technical solution. You lead strategic technical planning and processes. You conduct relevant and actionable analysis to support business growth.

  

Key responsibilities

* Oversee the management of the entire SAP ERP solution, ensuring synergy among platform products.

* Collaborate with stakeholders on designing relevant business solutions for Finance, Sales, Supply Chain, Production, HR, etc.

About you

Nancy Chen at Nancy.chen@dormerpramet.com

Dormer Pramet is a leading global supplier of metal cutting tools and related services, part of Sandvik Group. **The manufacturing industry has always been about working together.** We exist to protect that legacy, leading the way with a globally connected network of manufacturers, partners and suppliers to deliver certainty at every turn.
