For customers, and for the entire manufacturing community.

title: Finance Reporting Manager
description:
**ERM** is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.


The **Global Delivery Centre** (GDC) in Gurugram is ERM’s global operating backbone. It delivers business enablement services in Finance, HR, IT, and Commercial Operations to ensure ERM’s global business runs seamlessly, efficiently, and consistently.


At the GDC, you will:

* Be part of a hub that ensures ERM’s business continuity worldwide.
* Collaborate with colleagues across geographies to support global operations.
* Drive consistency, compliance, and efficiency in core functions.
* Work with digital, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to optimise how ERM operates.
* Work in shifts where required, depending on the role. As processes mature and automation increases, reliance on shifts will reduce.

**Why this role matters?**


As a **Finance Reporting Manager**, you will support ERM's global delivery by providing accurate financial reporting, forecasting, and analytical insights that enable informed business decision\-making. You will work within the Finance \& Operations Support team, partnering with global finance leaders, regional business units, and the Global Delivery Centre to ensure consistent financial reporting, effective cost management, and strong financial controls. This role is critical to enhancing financial visibility, supporting business performance, maintaining compliance, and driving operational efficiency across ERM's global network.

**What your impact is?**


Success in this role will be measured through the ability to:

* Deliver timely, accurate, and insightful financial reporting to support strategic and operational decision\-making.
* Improve forecasting accuracy and provide clear visibility into financial risks and opportunities across business units.
* Drive effective Global Capability Centre (GCC) recharge processes, ensuring transparency and consistency across regions.
* Strengthen financial controls, reporting governance, and data integrity across finance operations.
* Build strong relationships with global stakeholders and act as a trusted finance business partner.
* Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and efficiencies that enhance reporting quality and reduce manual effort.

**What will you bring?**

* CA, ICWA/CMA, or MBA (Finance) qualification with 6\+ years of relevant finance experience in a multinational environment.
* Strong experience in financial reporting, month\-end close, management reporting, and financial analysis.
* Proven ability to support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and managing cross\-functional relationships across multiple regions.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, data analysis, and reporting tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines, and work independently in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred qualifications, skills \& competencies**

* Experience in a Global Capability Centre (GCC), shared services, or multinational corporate environment.
* Exposure to intercompany accounting, recharge mechanisms, and cross\-border financial operations.
* Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, NetSuite, or similar finance platforms.
* Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Experience driving process automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Project management experience and exposure to finance transformation programs.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting.
* Prepare and review P\&L, Balance Sheet, management reports, reconciliations, accruals, and journal entries.
* Conduct detailed variance analysis against budgets, forecasts, and prior\-year performance.
* Prepare monthly reporting packs and financial commentary for management and business leaders.
* Manage GCC recharge processes, ensuring accurate cost allocation and reconciliation across legal entities and cost centres.
* Partner with regional finance teams to validate recharge calculations and resolve financial discrepancies.
* Support annual budgeting and monthly forecasting processes by providing financial insights and analysis.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders to gather financial data, address reporting requirements, and support business reviews.
* Develop and maintain reporting processes, calendars, documentation, and control frameworks.
* Drive continuous improvement, automation initiatives, and enhancement of reporting efficiencies.
* Support internal and external audit requirements and ensure compliance with financial policies and controls.
* Act as a trusted finance partner, providing data\-driven recommendations to support business performance and decision\-making.

 **WORK EXPERIENCE**

* 20\+ years (incl. 15\+ years in workforce management, forecasting, or capacity planning and 5\+ years leading multi\-business / multi\-site teams)

 **TECHNICAL SKILLS**

* Enterprise hands\-on model design covering demand, workload, productivity, shrinkage, service levels, location, and skill mix
* Advanced forecasting and quantitative methods: time\-series, regression, causal drivers, seasonality,
* Multi\-horizon demand and capacity planning across portfolios; workforce strategy
* Expert Excel model development and assurance: Power Query, advanced formulas, PivotTables, scenario engines, dashboards
* Planning governance, data standards, model risk controls, benefits tracking, and executive decision support

 **BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS**

* Executive presence and ability to influence business, finance, HR, and operations leaders using evidence
* Strategic and commercial thinking while remaining close enough to the data to test and challenge models personally
* Ability to lead change, standardize planning practices, and resolve competing priorities across businesses and locations
* Strong talent leadership — builds a high\-calibre WFM capability and succession pipeline
* Clear ownership, intellectual curiosity, and resilience when recommendations challenge established assumptions

 **JOB OVERVIEW**


The Workforce Management Associate Director will set the workforce planning strategy, governance, and operating model across multiple businesses, sites, or geographies. This player\-coach role combines senior stakeholder leadership with hands\-on expertise in WFM models, forecasting, demand and capacity planning, advanced Excel, and quantitative techniques. The incumbent will establish a single planning methodology, challenge investment and hiring assumptions, and ensure workforce decisions are aligned to service, cost, growth, and transformation priorities.

 **CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and own the enterprise WFM strategy, methodology, governance, data standards, model controls, and planning calendar across multiple businesses or sites
* Personally review and, where required, build critical forecasting, demand, and capacity models; challenge assumptions, methodologies, forecast bias, and investment cases
* Integrate long\-range business outlook, budgets, transformation roadmaps, automation, location strategy, attrition, hiring, learning curves, and productivity into workforce scenarios
* Chair executive capacity reviews and present clear choices, risks, costs, and service implications to enable hiring, location, skill, vendor, and productivity decisions
* Establish performance measures for forecast accuracy, utilisation, occupancy, shrinkage, capacity adherence, productivity, and plan benefits; drive corrective action across owners
* Lead and develop the WFM organisation, strengthen quantitative and Excel capability, and partner with Finance, HR, Operations, and Technology to mature tools and planning automation

 **OTHER ROLE DETAILS**

* Enterprise WFM Strategy
* Forecasting \& Capacity Governance
* Executive Decision Support

We offer a variety of workstyle options through our Smart Working model, but we also recognize that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it!  

  

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips colleagues to learn, share and grow, helping them achieve their fullest potential. As a result, Aon colleagues are more connected, more relevant and more valued.

**Job Description**
-------------------

***Objective / Purpose:***

*Describe at the highest level the team where this job sits and how this role will contribute to the team’s delivery of critical function.*

* Serve as a Senior Manager\-level Clinical Data Scientist within Data \& Quantitative Sciences, applying statistical, data science, and analytical methods to support clinical development programs.
* Partner with cross\-functional study teams to deliver analysis\-ready data, perform quantitative analyses, interpret results, and generate decision\-support insights.
* Deliver fit\-for\-purpose statistical, data science, and advanced analytics activities for assigned studies and study\-level workstreams.
* Collaborate with Clinical, Clinical Pharmacology, PSPV, Clinical Data Management, Translational Sciences, Regulatory, Clinical Operations, Statistical Programming, and external partners to support high\-quality, traceable, analysis\-ready, and submission\-ready data.
* Apply modern clinical data science practices, including automation, reusable analytics workflows, and AI/ML\-enabled approaches, while maintaining scientific rigor, regulatory awareness, and patient\-focused decision making.

***Accountabilities:***

*Primary duties and responsibilities; essential functions only.*

* Execute clinical data science activities for assigned studies, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality analyses, data review, and quantitative insights that support study objectives.
* Perform exploratory analyses, data visualization, and quantitative assessments using clinical trial, biomarker, external, and real\-world data sources.
* Collaborate with Clinical Data Management, Clinical Pharmacology, PSPV, Clinical Operations, and Translational Sciences to support study objectives and evidence generation.
* Translate scientific and clinical questions into analysis\-ready datasets, specifications, and reproducible analytical workflows.
* Support integrated data review activities by identifying data trends, inconsistencies, and potential risks requiring further investigation.
* Apply established statistical, machine learning, simulation, and visualization methods to support interpretation of study results and development decisions.
* Contribute to the review of analysis outputs, visualizations, and technical documentation to ensure quality, traceability, and reproducibility of deliverables.
* Review and contribute to analysis outputs produced by internal teams and external partners, ensuring quality and adherence to established standards and processes.
* Identify and communicate risks related to data quality, analytical assumptions, timelines, and quantitative outputs to functional stakeholders.
* Contribute to continuous improvement efforts through automation, reusable code, standard methodologies, and adoption of approved technologies and workflows.
* Contribute to departmental standards, process improvements, and technology adoption initiatives as assigned.
* Share technical expertise and support onboarding and development of less experienced team member

***Education \& Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):***

*Essential and desirable education and competency requirements to perform the primary responsibilities of the job.*

**Education / Experience**

* PhD in statistics, biostatistics, data science, epidemiology, biomedical engineering, computer science, quantitative sciences, or related field with 5\+ years of relevant experience; or MS with 7\+ years of relevant experience. Equivalent combinations should be reviewed with HR.
* Experience supporting quantitative analyses and data science activities within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare research, or other regulated clinical development environments.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute to clinical development decisions through quantitative analysis, data interpretation, and effective communication of evidence.
* Experience working effectively on cross\-functional study teams and collaborating across functional disciplines to achieve study objectives.
* Experience working with clinical trial data and one or more additional data types such as biomarker, real\-world, external, imaging, digital health, or other high\-dimensional data sources.

**Highest\-priority Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of clinical trial design, drug development, endpoints, estimands, biomarkers, data interpretation, and the role of analytics in clinical decision making.
* Strong foundation in statistics and quantitative methods, including longitudinal analysis, survival methods, causal reasoning, simulation, predictive modeling, and communication of uncertainty.
* Hands\-on proficiency in R and/or Python, with working knowledge of SAS and SQL; ability to develop, review, and support reproducible analyses, code quality, version control, and validated workflows.
* Working knowledge of CDISC standards, including SDTM, ADaM, controlled terminology, Define\-XML concepts, and submission\-oriented data expectations.
* Experience integrating, analyzing, and interpreting diverse data sources, including clinical trial, biomarker, real\-world, external, imaging, digital health, or high\-dimensional data as appropriate to assigned studies.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML and advanced analytics in regulated clinical development, including model development, validation, documentation, assumptions, bias considerations, and fit\-for\-purpose deployment.
* Knowledge of FDA, EMA, ICH\-GCP, GxP, data privacy, inspection readiness, and traceability expectations relevant to clinical data and quantitative deliverables.
* Ability to develop clear analysis specifications, visualization approaches, documentation, and interpretation summaries suitable for scientific, operational, and study\-team audiences.
* Familiarity with modern data platforms, reusable analytics workflows, automation, metadata\-driven processes, and governed data standards.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Communicates quantitative findings clearly to scientific, operational, technical, and leadership audiences.
* Builds effective working relationships across study teams and functional partners.
* Demonstrates strong technical credibility, sound judgment, and collaborative problem\-solving skills.

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.  



  

**The Global Employee Data Analyst** works closely with the HR Capability Center to safeguard the integrity of employee data in the Workday transactions, while owning high\-volume employee documentation and statutory compliance activities (EPFO and NPS).


The role processes new hire, job change, time off and absence transactions, and employee/manager direct access submissions, ensuring all data is actioned accurately and on time. It maintains foundational data such as supervisory organizations, cost center assignments and position titles, and completes weekly payroll reconciliation — reviewing audit reports, analyzing discrepancies and processing updates so the Workday\-to\-payroll feed remains correct.


In parallel, the role prepares employment verification and compliance documentation, coordinates with third\-party compliance vendors, and resolves Provident Fund (PF), Pension and NPS matters within statutory timelines. Success in this position requires exceptional attention to detail, the ability to manage high transaction volumes accurately, and working knowledge of HCM and statutory processes.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Workday Data Management \& Employee Records**

* Maintain and/or approve all data pertaining to employee records in Workday (transfers, personal information, title changes, etc.) entered in Workday through Manager or Employee Direct Access.
* Complete pending new hire transactions in Workday HCM once the candidate reaches Ready to Hire status in the ATS.
* Support execution of employee movement, employee status, time off and leave of absence, payroll, benefits, Performance Check\-ins and compensation processes through accurate, on\-time data maintenance.
* Maintain supervisory organizations, organization assignments, cost center assignments and position titles.
* Support the integrity of employee records and Workday data, assuring legal and regulatory compliance.
* Review integration kickout reports from various systems and process corresponding updates in Workday.
* Complete reports, documents and forms requiring HCM data, including People Doc processes.
* Reviewing audit reports, analyzing discrepancies and processing appropriate updates.
* Process employee reimbursement transactions: validate submitted documentation and request payment via payroll.

**Statutory Compliance – PF, Pension \& NPS**

* Handle employee queries relating to Provident Fund (PF) and Pension accounts, including cases requiring correction.
* Review PF passbooks and employee service history to identify discrepancies and evaluate the root cause of correction requests.
* Coordinate with employees and vendors to prepare addendum letters, correction letters and supporting documentation for PF/Pension corrections.
* Approve KYC updates and PF transfer requests on the EPFO/PF portal in line with compliance requirements, ensuring all corrections and transfers are processed within statutory timelines.
* Collect revised Form 11 submissions and route them to the next\-level team for action.
* Manage monthly NPS linking letters, NPS portal approvals and reporting requests in line with company policies, benefits and compliance requirements.

**Vendor Coordination**

* Act as the primary point of contact for third\-party compliance vendors.
* Review, validate and prepare vendor\-issued compliance letters for accuracy prior to issuance.
* Track vendor deliverables and ensure timely closure of compliance requests.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify, troubleshoot and escalate issues as appropriate, and make process recommendations to achieve operational excellence.
* Enhance content, FAQs and LWIs based on case resolution feedback, in collaboration with functional teams.
* Identify and report case or product trends to management and Senior WFA, working with HR functional teams to improve service to the workforce.
* Work collaboratively across the HR team for consistent execution of key HR processes across regions and functional areas.
* Collaborate with all functional teams so People Services collectively achieves TAT
* Participate ad\-hoc projects and other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in or equivalent qualification in HR (HR specialization preferred).
* Minimum 5 years working with HRIS/HCM systems; 5\+ years in HR administration, compliance or a related field preferred.

**The team**



Businesses are continuously exploring opportunities to grow / rationalize costs and mergers and acquisitions, or carve\-outs through separations and divestitures, are among the most complex business activities an organization will undertake. Deloitte’s global network of consulting



practitioner’s help clients identify and solve their most critical information and transformational challenges. With market\-leading expertise in 17 industry segments, superior business transformation capabilities, and deep technical expertise, our global network of more than 33,000 consulting practitioners create unmatched market offerings to solve our clients’ toughest business issues.



Mergers \& Acquisitions team helps strategize, design, and implement end\-to\-end solutions for successful transactions, from advance\-planning to post\-transaction restructuring. The team helps drive performance for businesses in every key M\&A\-related function: project management, commercial activity optimization, operations and supply chain, IT systems, human capital management, and finance activities. Learn more about our Strategy \& Transactions Practice

  


**Your work profile**



Professionals in M\&A group offer both advisory and deployment services that provide clients with comprehensive solutions to help them better manage the critical business functions.



We accomplish this mission through continued development of people in our Strategy, Risk and Transactions \- M\&A: Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration



The primary role is to make direct contributions to the engagement team by assisting financial services clients (preferably banking) on Organization Readiness and integration or carve\-outs in a deal / M\&A scenario.

  




**Delivery of specific capability in FS M\&A: DT \& PMI**


**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C\-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100\), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in Integration Management office (IMO) for end\-to\-end program management of workstreams involved in the Integration process
  


**Integration support for post\-deal activities:**


* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness
* Day 1 / 100 Readiness planning
* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis\-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization
  


**Carve\-out and separation:**

* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re\-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100\) and desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in managing the Separation Management Office (SMO) across the workstreams
* Assess the TSA requirements, prepare TSA schedules and TSA exit strategies
* Cost modelling for one\-time and recurring costs due to separation (stranded cost, standalone costs etc.)
* Define step\- wise separation road map
  


**Commercial and Operational Diligence and Transformation:**

* Evaluate the strategic and commercial feasibility of a deal / transaction
* Evaluate the current business capabilities and identify red flags on operational issues/risks
* Assess the Post deal consolidation and transformation opportunities
* Leverage industry best practices and Deloitte accelerators to define methodological approach to consolidation / separation
* Undertake detailed functional integration planning (e.g. Sales and Marketing, operations, Finance, IT, HR etc.) for Day 1 /100 and End state
* Support delivery of functional plans

  


**Synergy / dis\-synergy assessment \& delivery:**

* Identify areas of potential synergies / dis\-synergies and establish the degree of integration required
* Define road map for delivery of synergies and advise on synergy benefits tracking
* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization

  


**Key skills required:**


* Candidate should be able to demonstrate experience of working on large transformations including pre\-deal or post\-deal M\&A transactions in FS / banking space
* Candidate should possess good knowledge of banking value chain from a business standpoint including experience of working within one or more banking functions, or as an advisor working with one or more banking functions
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting with 3 \- 12 years of relevant experience in financial services industry preferably banking

title: HR Manager

Position
   

 HR Manager
   

  

 Reporting To
   

 Director / Head – Human Resources
   

 Location

 Employment Type
   

 Full\-Time
   

 Experience Required
   

 5–8\+ years of progressive experience in Human Resources, preferably in the manufacturing industry.
   

 Educational Qualification
   

 • MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent.
   

 • Additional certifications in Labour Laws, Talent Management, HR Analytics, or Learning \& Development will be an advantage.
   

 About the Role
   

 The HR Manager will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle, ensuring that HR strategies, policies, and practices support the organization's business objectives. The role includes Talent Acquisition, Employee Engagement, Performance Management, Learning \& Development, HR Operations, Compliance, Payroll Coordination, Employee Relations, and Exit Management while maintaining a positive workplace culture.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 1\. Workforce Planning \& Recruitment
   

 • Develop manpower plans in coordination with department heads.
   

 • Prepare and update Job Descriptions (JDs).
   

 • Manage recruitment for blue\-collar, white\-collar, and leadership positions.
   

 • Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, consultants, and campus hiring.
   

 • Screen resumes and conduct initial interviews.
   

 • Coordinate technical and management interviews.
   

 • Manage candidate communication throughout the hiring process.
   

 • Conduct salary negotiations and issue offer letters.
   

 • Maintain recruitment reports, hiring metrics, and recruitment dashboards.
   

 • Build employer branding initiatives.
   

 2\. Onboarding \& Induction
   

 • Ensure timely documentation before joining.
   

 • Coordinate pre\-joining formalities.
   

 • Conduct employee induction and orientation.
   

 • Introduce company policies, culture, and organizational structure.
   

 • Coordinate department\-wise onboarding.
   

 • Ensure smooth integration of new employees.
   

 3\. HR Operations
   

 • Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
   

 • Generate employment letters, confirmation letters, promotion letters, transfer letters, and experience certificates.
   

 • Maintain employee database and HRIS.
   

 • Monitor attendance and leave management.
   

 • Coordinate payroll inputs with Finance.
   

 • Ensure accurate employee documentation.
   

 4\. Performance Management
   

 • Design and implement performance appraisal systems.
   

 • Coordinate probation reviews and employee confirmations.
   

 • Monitor KPIs and KRAs.
   

 • Support managers during performance review discussions.
   

 • Identify high\-potential employees.
   

 • Develop Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) where required.
   

 5\. Learning \& Development
   

 • Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA).
   

 • Prepare annual training calendars.
   

 • Organize technical, behavioral, leadership, and compliance training programs.
   

 • Evaluate training effectiveness.
   

 • Track employee learning and certifications.
   

 • Develop succession planning initiatives.
   

 6\. Employee Engagement
   

 • Plan employee engagement activities and recognition programs.
   

 • Conduct employee satisfaction surveys.
   

 • Organize wellness initiatives, festivals, and team\-building events.
   

 • Promote a positive work culture.
   

 • Address employee concerns proactively.
   

 7\. Employee Relations
   

 • Handle employee grievances confidentially.
   

 • Counsel employees and managers on workplace issues.
   

 • Resolve conflicts through effective communication.
   

 • Promote fairness, diversity, and inclusion.
   

 • Support disciplinary processes where required.
   

 8\. Compensation \& Benefits
   

 • Coordinate payroll processing.
   

 • Review salary structures and benefits.
   

 • Manage annual increments and promotions.
   

 • Support compensation benchmarking.
   

 • Ensure statutory deductions are accurate.
   

 9\. HR Compliance \& Labour Laws
   

 • Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws.
   

 • Maintain statutory registers and records.
   

 • Coordinate compliance audits.
   

 • Liaise with government authorities when required.
   

 • Ensure timely filing of statutory returns.
   

 • Implement company HR policies and procedures.
   

 10\. HR Policies \& Process Improvement
   

 • Develop and update HR policies.
   

 • Improve HR processes through automation and digitalization.
   

 • Monitor HR KPIs.
   

 • Ensure policy awareness across the organization.
   

 • Drive continuous improvement initiatives.
   

 11\. HR Analytics \& Reporting
   

 • Prepare monthly HR MIS reports.
   

 • Analyze recruitment metrics and attrition trends.
   

 • Present HR dashboards to management.
   

 • Provide workforce planning insights.
   

 • Support data\-driven HR decision\-making.
   

 12\. Employee Separation \& Retirement
   

 • Manage resignations, retirements, and terminations.
   

 • Conduct exit interviews.
   

 • Coordinate full and final settlements.
   

 • Ensure return of company assets.
   

 • Issue relieving letters, experience certificates, and other exit documents.
   

 • Maintain employee separation records.
   

 • Analyze attrition data and recommend retention strategies.

 Manufacturing, Engineering, Industrial Products, Technical Textiles, Infrastructure, or similar sectors.

 • Collaborative work environment with opportunities for growth.
   

 • Chance to contribute to organizational development and employee success.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
description:
Senior Human Resources Manager
 
**Location:** 
 Thane, Maharashtra
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
 



**Company:** 
 Lunar Wave LLC
 


 About Lunar Wave LLC
 
 Lunar Wave LLC is a fast\-growing digital products and performance marketing company. We operate multiple consumer\-facing digital brands and are building a high\-performance team across creative strategy, media buying, design, video editing, technology and operations.
 



 As we grow, we're looking for an experienced
 **Senior Human Resources Manager** 
 who can take complete ownership of our people function and help us build a high\-performance, accountable and positive work culture.
 


 About the Role
 
 This is not a purely administrative HR position.
 



 We're looking for someone who can independently manage the entire employee lifecycle while acting as a strong bridge between employees, managers and leadership.
 



 You will be responsible for creating structure, improving communication, resolving employee concerns, strengthening managers, managing performance and ensuring that problems are identified and addressed before they escalate.
 



 You should be comfortable working directly with the Founder and leadership team and confident enough to give honest feedback when something needs to change.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Own end\-to\-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening to interviews, offers and onboarding
* Build and maintain HR policies, SOPs and employee processes
* Manage attendance, leaves, payroll coordination, employee records and HR documentation
* Design and manage performance reviews, KPIs, feedback systems, PIPs and improvement plans
* Conduct regular employee 1\-on\-1s and identify recurring concerns or workplace issues
* Handle employee grievances professionally, confidentially and objectively
* Resolve conflicts between employees, managers and teams before they escalate
* Coach Team Leads and managers on communication, feedback and people management
* Build clear escalation and grievance\-resolution processes
* Improve employee engagement, communication and overall workplace culture
* Identify high performers, underperformers and potential retention risks
* Manage promotions, increments, warnings, disciplinary processes and exits
* Conduct structured onboarding and exit interviews
* Organize employee engagement activities and team initiatives
* Ensure compliance with applicable employment policies and requirements
* Provide leadership with regular insights into employee sentiment, performance and organizational issues
* Build HR systems that can support the company as the team continues to grow


 What We're Looking For
 * **5\+ years of HR experience** 
 , preferably in a startup, agency, e\-commerce, technology or other fast\-growing organization
* Previous experience independently managing an HR function or team
* Strong experience in
 **employee relations and conflict resolution**
* **Strong understanding of performance management and KPI\-driven organizations**
* **Experience handling difficult conversations, grievances and disciplinary situations**
* **Strong recruitment and talent acquisition capabilities**
* **Excellent communication and people\-management skills**
* **Ability to remain neutral and objective during employee conflicts**
* **Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, high\-accountability environment**
* **Strong judgment, discretion and confidentiality**
* **Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions**
* **Comfortable working directly with senior leadership and challenging decisions respectfully when necessary**


 The Person We'd Like to Hire
 
 We want someone who is
 **approachable enough that employees feel comfortable speaking openly, but strong enough to handle difficult situations objectively.** 




**You should be able to distinguish between a genuine employee concern, a management problem, a performance problem and unproductive workplace behaviour.** 




**Most importantly, we're looking for someone who believes that a great workplace can have both:** 




**Employee freedom and a positive environment, while maintaining high standards of performance and accountability.** 



 Why Join Lunar Wave?
 
 You'll have the opportunity to build and shape the HR function of a growing company rather than simply maintaining an existing system.
 



 You'll work closely with the Founder and leadership team and have significant ownership over hiring, performance management, employee experience and company culture.
 



**Work Location:** 
 Thane, Maharashtra
 



**Work Mode:** 
 100% On\-site
 


* **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time

The Talent Acquisition Manager will be responsible for full recruitment life cycle, and should be able to use best sourcing methodologies according to the positions \-job portals, Candidate reference, Database, Networking, LinkedIn, head Hunting, etc. Must have IT Recruitment experience.

This role centers on architecting seamless data synchronization workflows between Apollo.io, Zoho CRM, and internal databases to eliminate manual data entry and streamline outbound and inbound sales operations.  


The position demands a solid understanding of core programming logic, structured data handling, and backend communication. Rather than generic UI design, your primary focus will be designing webhook listeners, mapping data schemas between distinct platforms, handling API rate limits, and implementing error\-handling pipelines to ensure zero data discrepancies across our business systems.

* Write clean, modular, and maintainable scripts to parse, clean, transform, and map complex, multi\-nested JSON payloads between third\-party services and database schemas.
* Implement robust error\-handling mechanisms, including retry logic, data deduplication, and payload validation checkpoints to handle API rate limits and prevent data corruption.
* Conduct functional and integration testing using tools like Postman, validating endpoints, request headers, authentication handshakes, payload integrity, and error response codes.
* Write and execute structured queries to store, reconcile, and audit synchronized sales records across databases, ensuring strict schema integrity and data accuracy.
* Troubleshoot and resolve sync bottlenecks, payload mismatches, authentication token drops, and trigger failures across active integration pipelines.
* Document technical specifications, data mapping rules, endpoint configurations, and automation flowcharts to ensure clarity and ongoing maintainability.

* Strong algorithmic thinking and core programming logic, with proficiency in at least one scripting or backend language (Python or JavaScript / Node.js preferred).
* Solid understanding of RESTful architecture, HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), status codes, authentication protocols (API Keys, Bearer Tokens, OAuth 2\.0\), and Webhooks.
* Practical fluency in data handling, particularly with JSON parsing, data structures, schema mapping, and payload manipulation.
* Familiarity with, or a strong willingness to master, Zoho CRM (including Deluge scripting workflows) and Apollo.io API capabilities.
* Fundamental knowledge of databases, with the ability to write foundational SQL queries to fetch, update, and validate business records.
* Hands\-on exposure to development tools, specifically Git/GitHub for version control and Postman for API inspection and testing.
* Hands\-on experience developing academic, capstone, or personal software projects demonstrating core programming principles.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to articulate technical logic, document workflows, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving aptitude, high attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a genuine eagerness to learn modern integration tools.

description:
**About bluCognition** 




 bluCognition is an AI\-powered commercial credit intelligence company serving lenders and financial institutions. Our platform combines commercial credit data contributed by 150\+ lenders with AI\-driven analytics, banking data and fraud detection to help our clients make faster, better credit decisions. Our product suite includes bluSense, which converts bank statements into standardized, categorized transaction data with real\-time financial insights, and FraudLens, which detects document tampering and first\-party fraud. Alongside our data products, we run a managed services business supporting underwriting, fraud review, and KYC/KYB and sanctions screening operations for our clients, with teams across North America, Asia and Europe.
 



  





**About Role** 




 We are looking for an analytically curious, detail\-oriented professional with up to 4 years of experience in data science and credit risk, proficient in Python, SQL, and data analysis libraries, comfortable working with large datasets, with hands\-on exposure to credit risk or ML modelling concepts. You will work alongside experienced data scientists and risk professionals on ad\-hoc analyses, model validation, and bureau data exploration — including U.S. credit card portfolios — while building the skills to grow into more independent modelling responsibilities over time.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Perform ad\-hoc analysis on large\-scale data to extract actionable insights and support data\-driven decision making.
* Develop a strong understanding of the credit risk modelling lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, validation, and monitoring.
* Build foundational knowledge of machine learning techniques and their applications in credit risk, including classification, regression, and ensemble methods.
* Support validation of existing credit risk models and assist in developing or enhancing models under the guidance of senior team members.
* Extract, manipulate, and explore large datasets using Python (pandas and related data analysis libraries) and SQL to ensure data quality and integrity.
* Communicate analytical findings and model results clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including leadership presentations.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Must\-Have: 2–4 years in data science or credit risk analytics; proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy) and SQL; foundational ML knowledge (logistic regression, decision trees, gradient boosting); strong communication skills.
* Strong Advantage: Exposure to credit bureau data or consumer lending data; academic/project experience with credit scoring or risk modelling.
* Tools (if applicable): Python (pandas, NumPy), SQL, Power BI, and AWS / cloud\-based data platforms.

* Perform vulnerability assessments across network, server, endpoint, cloud, mobile application, and web application environments.

* Understanding of OWASP, NIST, PCI\-DSS, ISO 27001, and cloud security concepts.
* Strong analytical, reporting, communication, and collaboration skills.


**Preferred Certifications:** 
 CEH, ECSA, CHFI, or equivalent cybersecurity certifications.

title: AI Red Team Tester
description:
**About The Role**
 If you've ever looked at a system and immediately started thinking about how to break it — this role was made for you. We're looking for security\-minded professionals to stress\-test AI systems, expose their weaknesses, and help build the next generation of safe, reliable AI.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your findings directly shape how AI behaves in the real world.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design and execute red\-teaming exercises to uncover security weaknesses in AI systems
* Craft adversarial prompts and edge\-case scenarios to probe model guardrails and safety filters
* Evaluate AI outputs for unsafe behavior, bias, and policy violations
* Document vulnerabilities, exploits, and unexpected behaviors in clear, structured reports
* Collaborate with engineering teams to recommend practical mitigations and improvements
* Stay current on emerging AI security threats, jailbreak techniques, and adversarial research
* Help define and refine security evaluation rubrics and testing protocols


**Who You Are**
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts — threat modeling, penetration testing, or ethical hacking
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML systems, large language models, or prompt engineering
* Creative and analytical — you enjoy finding the edge cases others miss
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills
* Comfortable working independently in an asynchronous, task\-based environment
* Familiarity with open\-source AI platforms or LLM ecosystems is a plus
* Background in infosec, AI safety research, or adversarial ML is a bonus — but not required


**Why Join Us**
* Work at the cutting edge of AI security alongside top research labs
* See your work directly improve the safety of AI products used by millions of people
* Full autonomy and a flexible schedule — work when and how you work best
* Build deep, marketable expertise in one of the fastest\-growing fields in tech
* Ongoing contract potential with opportunities to expand scope and responsibility
* Be part of a global community of experts shaping the future of responsible AI

* Exposure to multiple OEM technologies and IT/ELV projects.
* Opportunity to work on corporate and enterprise projects.

title: Account Associate - USA Accounting
description:
**About the Company**

Divine Force I India is a professional services company providing dedicated business and operational support to international clients. This position is exclusively assigned to support **Boulder Construction**, a U.S.\-based construction company specializing primarily in hotel and residential construction projects.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and organized Account Associate to support the accounting and financial operations of U.S.\-based construction projects.

The role will involve managing invoices, maintaining financial records, updating Schedules of Values (SOVs), tracking expenses, assisting with reconciliations and financial closing, and coordinating with Project Managers, subcontractors, and suppliers.

The ideal candidate should have strong accounting fundamentals, excellent attention to detail, good Excel and QuickBooks knowledge, and strong English communication skills.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Maintain a detailed log of all company and project\-related transactions, including storing, organizing, and labeling the backups properly (i.e., invoices, receipts, lien waivers, etc.).
* Maintain and update Schedules of Values (SOVs) for accurate project billing from subcontractors or suppliers.
* Handle the management and filing of all invoices, ensuring they are accurate and processed in a timely manner.
* Manage and categorize expenses to maintain accurate financial records and reporting.
* Reconcile accounts and assist with financial closing processes.
* Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards specific to the construction industry.
* Assist in tax preparation and filing, including managing W9, W2, and other tax\-related documents.
* Liaise with project managers to align financial reporting with project budgets, proper allocations, and projections.
* Use QuickBooks for construction financial management.
* Collaborate with external auditors to validate financial practices and records during audits.
* Analyze financial data (on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis) and prepare detailed reports to support decision\-making for construction projects.
* Draft and send emails to counterparties regarding invoicing and other financials updates/questions.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; Master’s degree or CPA is preferred.
* Expert\-level MS Excel and QuickBooks experience/knowledge is required, preferably within a construction context.
* Solid understanding of GAAP and financial principles applicable to construction.
* Exceptional analytical skills and precision in financial management.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and remote work skills.
* Extreme attention to detail.
* Fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking).

**Benefits:**

* Performance\-based annual bonus opportunities
* 18 paid leaves per year \+ 9 Indian national holidays
* Opportunity to work directly with a U.S.\-based construction company and gain international exposure
* Fast career growth opportunities in a rapidly expanding organization
* Learning and development through real project involvement from day one
* Collaborative and supportive team environment
* Stable, long\-term career opportunity with a growing company
* Clear growth path with role expansion opportunities
* Opportunity to take ownership and help build new systems and processes
* 5\-Day Working (Monday to Friday)

**Freshers or candidates with 1\-2 years of experience are preferred.**

**Only apply if you have strong verbal and written English communication skills and are eager to learn and grow.**

**Candidates must be based in Vadodara or surrounding locations.**

Job Type: Full\-time

* **Work Location**: In person (Vadodara, GJ) Alembic City
* **General Shift:** 5:00 PM – 2:00 AM IST

· **Industry: IT \& Construction**

Work Location: In person

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**


  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Ops Staff** is responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operational activities within Blue Dart's Service Centres, Hubs, Processing Units (PUDs) and Warehouses by ensuring efficient shipment handling, processing and movement across the network.


The role performs a wide range of operational activities including shipment receiving, sorting, scanning, bagging, tagging, loading, unloading, shipment reconciliation and data entry while ensuring adherence to operational procedures, safety standards and service commitments. As a frontline operations employee, the incumbent plays a critical role in maintaining shipment accuracy, operational productivity and service quality while representing the Blue Dart brand through professional conduct, discipline and operational excellence.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To support efficient shipment processing and operational activities by ensuring accurate handling, sorting, scanning and movement of shipments while maintaining high standards of productivity, safety, quality and compliance with Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Shipment Processing \& Operations**

* Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.
* Perform shipment scanning, bagging, tagging and labelling activities in accordance with operational requirements.
* Support loading and unloading of shipments from vehicles while ensuring safe handling practices.
* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

**Data Entry \& Operational Documentation**

* Perform basic data entry and shipment updates using approved operational systems.
* Ensure accurate recording of shipment information and operational transactions.
* Verify shipment labels, manifests and operational documentation.
* Report shipment discrepancies or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain accuracy in operational records and documentation.

**Operational Support**

* Support day\-to\-day operations across Service Centres, Hubs, Warehouses and Processing Units.
* Assist Shift In\-charges in achieving daily operational targets.
* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) while performing operational activities.
* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Teamwork \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with colleagues across operational teams.
* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of experience in logistics, warehousing, courier, manufacturing, retail operations or similar operational environments.
* Freshers with the aptitude and willingness to work in operational roles are encouraged to apply.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years**.
* Physically fit to perform operational activities involving standing, walking, lifting and movement of shipments throughout the shift.
* Willingness to work across rotational shifts, weekends and public holidays based on business requirements.
* Basic understanding of English for reading operational instructions, shipment labels and safety guidelines.
* Basic computer and handheld scanner/mobile application usage.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Shipment Sorting \& Segregation
* Shipment Scanning \& Processing
* Bagging, Tagging \& Labelling
* Shipment Loading \& Unloading
* Basic Data Entry
* Shipment Reconciliation
* Barcode Scanner \& Mobile Device Usage
* Basic Computer Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Operational Discipline
* Customer Focus
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Attention to Detail
* Integrity \& Accountability
* Time Management
* Learning Agility
* Safety Consciousness
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Grooming \& Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Processed • Sorting \& Processing Productivity • SLA Adherence

  

  

Quality \& Accuracy

  

Scanning Accuracy • Zero Mis\-sort • Shipment Handling Accuracy

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

SOP Compliance • Safety Compliance • Zero Safety Violations

  

  

Operational Discipline

  

Attendance • Punctuality • Uniform \& Grooming Standards • Workplace Discipline

  

  

Teamwork \& Operational Support

  

Team Collaboration • Process Adherence • Support During Peak Operations \& Continuous Learning


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

title: Associate Key Account Manager - Sales
description:
**Experience**: 0\-2 years in any service selling \- insurance, edtech, fintech, real estate, hospitality, SaaS, staffing, telecom. Freshers with genuine hustle welcome.

**Sell ₹50 lakh\+ multi media campaigns before you turn 25\.**

Excellent Publicity is a full\-service advertising and media agency. Since 2011 we have planned and bought media for 5,000\+ brands across 3,00,000\+ successful campaigns \- hoardings, airports, metro and transit, newspapers, radio, cinema, television, digital, performance, influencer \& sports. We are an energetic team across Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Pune \& Dubai, and with strong in\-house tech team building superlative AI\-powered products, having built \& released two such products already \- EPitch that builds detailed media plans \& strategies in hours that most agencies take a fortnight to produce, while Atlas that makes offline advertising as measurable \& transparent as digital.

We are hiring Associate Key Account Managers into four sales pods. **This is not a support role.** From month three you carry your own accounts, your own target and your own incentive cheque.

**What you will actually do**

* **Entire World is your territory.** You decide which brands are worth chasing and you build the list yourself.
* **Get to the decision maker.** Marketing Heads, CMOs, founders. Cold calls, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, walk\-ins, industry events \- we do not prescribe the method, we look at the meetings.
* **Sit in the pitch.** In the room from week one. Presenting parts of it yourself by the end of quarter one.
* **Build the commercial.** Work with our media team to turn a client brief into a media plan, a costing and a proposal that wins.
* **Close, then keep.** Renewals and upsells on your own accounts earn you incentive again. The book you build is the book you are paid on.

**Your first 90 days:**

**1st nd 2nd week\-** Media 101 \- how OOH, print, radio, cinema, TV and digital are actually bought and priced. Shadow live client calls. Be in the room in real client meetings.

**3rd – 6th Week\-** Build your prospect list. First 100 outbound conversations. Sit in on live pitches. Also handle our inbound inquiries from our Media buying platform as well as the GTM we run.

**7th – 12th Week\-** Run your own first\-meeting pitches. Co\-own live proposals. First closure expected inside month four.

**What you will earn:**

**Fixed CTC** \- ₹3,00,000 – ₹4,20,000 p.a.

**Incentive** \- Uncapped, linked to gross profit on every deal you close, paid quarterly

Same

**Realistic Year\-1 total, on target**

₹5,50,000 – ₹7,00,000

Fixed band is benchmarked to experience. **The incentive is where the money is, and there is no ceiling on it.** Our strongest performers have crossed ₹10 L in total earnings inside two years.

**Where this goes:**

**Month 0 – 3**: Learn the media landscape. Shadow live pitches. Build your prospect list.

**Month 3 – 12**: Carry an individual target. Close your first accounts.

**Month 12 – 18**: Promotion to Key Account Manager \- larger mandates, key accounts, materially higher fixed band.

**Beyond**: City or category ownership. We are opening new markets and we promote from inside.

**Who we are looking for**

* You can hold a conversation with someone twenty years senior without folding.
* You are fine being told "no" eight times before you get a "yes".
* You write a clear email and put together a decent PowerPoint.
* You are curious about brands \- why they advertise where they do, and why they spend what they spend.
* Fluent English and Hindi. Gujarati is a strong plus for Ahmedabad.
* Any graduate. A track record of selling something \- even a college fest sponsorship \- matters more than the degree.

**Not required:** advertising experience, an MBA, or a marketing degree. We have built strong sellers out of people from insurance, edtech inside sales, telecom, real estate and retail.

**How to apply**

Do not send only a CV \- we get hundreds and most read identical.

**Send two things to chahal@excellentpublicity.com or \+917486031011**

**1\.** Your CV.

**2\.** A 60\-second voice note answering: *"Pick any brand you have noticed advertising in your city in the last month. Where did you see it, and who do you think they were trying to reach?"*

There is no right answer. We are listening for how you think and how you speak \- which is the job.

description:
**About Filo**

Filo is the world's only online instant live tutoring platform built to bring the power of one\-to\-one high\-frequency learning to students from all backgrounds. With Filo, students can connect to a live teacher for a one\-to\-one video session within 60 seconds, anytime, 24x7\. More than 5 million students across 25 countries have leveraged Filo in their day\-to\-day learning.

Filo helps students overcome learning gaps instantly, improving academic performance through personalized learning. Teachers are matched using Filo's patented algorithms from a network of over 60,000 expert tutors based on each student's profile and learning needs.

Our work has been recognized with the Gold Award at the National Award for e\-Governance (Government of India) and the Innovation Award by MeitY at the G20 stage. Filo has also been recognized by Google and Amazon for its product and engineering capabilities.

At Filo, we believe in the power of education to transform lives and are building innovative solutions to make quality learning accessible to every student.

As a Call Associate, you will interact with students and parents over phone calls, understand their learning needs, explain Filo's features and benefits, guide students on how to use the platform effectively, and assist them with basic issues. You will play an important role in helping students access personalized academic support whenever they need it.

This is a full\-time, in\-office opportunity for individuals who enjoy communicating with people, solving problems, and making a meaningful impact through education.

**Key Responsibilities**

Make outbound calls in Hindi and English to students and parents to introduce and promote the Filo app.

Clearly explain Filo's features, benefits, and value proposition to students and parents.

Understand students' academic needs and recommend relevant ways to use the Filo platform.

Guide students on how to ask academic questions and connect with teachers through the app.

Assist students and parents with basic technical, account, or usage\-related issues.

Follow up with students and parents to encourage app usage and improve engagement.

Maintain a high level of empathy, patience, and professionalism during every interaction.

Handle customer queries and concerns effectively and ensure a positive user experience.

Maintain accurate records of calls, conversations, follow\-ups, and outcomes.

Work towards assigned calling, engagement, and app adoption targets.

Share recurring customer feedback and issues with the relevant internal teams.

Contribute to initiatives aimed at improving student satisfaction, retention, and overall app adoption.

**Eligibility**

Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification.

Excellent verbal communication skills in Hindi and English.

Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.

Good listening, communication, and problem\-solving abilities.

Comfortable speaking with students and parents over the phone.

Comfortable using mobile applications and basic web applications.

Self\-motivated, target\-oriented, and willing to work in a fast\-paced environment.

Patient, empathetic, and passionate about helping students.

Prior experience in calling, customer support, sales, NGOs, government schools, or EdTech is an added advantage.

Freshers with strong communication skills are also encouraged to apply.

Willing to work from the office, Monday to saturday

Hands\-on experience in customer engagement, calling, and business operations.

Opportunity to work closely with students and parents and contribute to their learning journey.

Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.

Exposure to the fast\-paced and innovative EdTech ecosystem.

Opportunity to develop communication, problem\-solving, customer handling, and target\-management skills.

Collaborative, inclusive, and learning\-focused work environment.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Company** 





 Eighty Days is building a new way to discover the world centred on taste, trust, and personal context. Today, travel discovery is fragmented across social media, search, and private conversations. We are creating a product that brings this together into a structured, map\-based experience where recommendations are attributed, meaningful, and built over time.
 





 Our focus is not just on helping people plan trips, but on becoming the place where they continuously save, organise, and revisit places that matter.
 





 Website:
 
 https://eightydays.ai/
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Design, build, and own LLM\-powered product features (chat and conversational modules, content understanding, recommendations) end to end on our NestJS/TypeScript backend: from product requirement, to production, to iteration based on real user behavior.
* Design and own the LLM interface layer: orchestration, tool calling, memory, evaluation, and the glue that makes agents and multi\-step pipelines reliable in production.
* Work fluently across many LLMs (proprietary and open\-source), choosing and routing the right model for each job based on quality, latency, and cost.
* Develop and maintain RAG systems: embedding generation, vector search (Qdrant), hybrid retrieval with Elasticsearch and MongoDB, and grounding LLM responses in first\-party data.
* Engineer for production performance: SSE streaming, prompt caching, token budgets, Redis\-backed session state, SQS\-based async processing, and observability.
* Build automated test suites and internal LLM evaluation tooling: regression tests for prompt and model changes, eval datasets curated from real user queries, and metrics for relevance, response quality, and groundedness.
* Translate business and product insights into working AI features, collaborating closely with the founder, backend engineers, and product.



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 1\.5\+ years of software engineering experience with strong TypeScript/Node.js skills (NestJS preferred).
* Shipped at least one LLM\-powered feature to production (chatbot, assistant, RAG system, content extraction pipeline, etc.), not just prototypes.
* Hands\-on experience with a major LLM API (Gemini, OpenAI, or Anthropic): prompt design, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and streaming.
* Working knowledge of embeddings, vector search (Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector, etc.), and RAG patterns.
* Production experience with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or Redis.
* Strong product sense: able to judge what makes an AI response genuinely useful and to balance quality, latency, and cost trade\-offs.
* Ownership mindset: can own a module end to end, from ambiguous requirement to shipped feature, with minimal oversight.
* Familiarity with AWS fundamentals (EC2/Beanstalk, S3, SQS).
* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience building LLM evaluation pipelines or working with eval frameworks.
* Exposure to agent frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain) or Model Context Protocol (MCP). Note: we build most pipelines directly on model APIs, so framework knowledge is a bonus, not a requirement.
* Experience with prompt caching, model routing, or LLM cost optimization at scale.
* Experience with messaging platform APIs (WhatsApp Cloud API, Instagram Graph API).
* Prior experience in a fast\-paced, AI\-driven startup environment.

title: xhibition & Space 3D Designer
description:
**Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly capable and technically proficient 3D Artist specializing in Exhibition Stall and Space Design to join our design team. The ideal candidate should possess a strong combination of creative visualization, technical understanding, spatial awareness, and practical knowledge of exhibition fabrication and execution.
 



 We follow an established space design pipeline and workflow, and the selected candidate will be expected to work seamlessly within this system while taking ownership of the complete 3D requirements for exhibition projects.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Develop sophisticated and visually compelling 3D exhibition stall and spatial designs based on project briefs, brand guidelines, site dimensions, and functional requirements.
 



 • Take complete ownership of the 3D design process, from initial interpretation of the brief through design development, visualization, revisions, and final presentation.
 



 • Adhere to the existing design pipeline, production workflow, and quality standards followed by the organization.
 



 • Translate conceptual ideas into technically sound, dimensionally accurate, and practically executable 3D environments.
 



 • Demonstrate a strong understanding of exhibition structures, fabrication techniques, construction methodologies, materials, finishes, and spatial limitations.
 



 • Evaluate the technical feasibility of proposed designs, identifying potential structural, fabrication, or execution\-related limitations at the design stage itself.
 



 • Ensure that proposed designs can be realistically fabricated, assembled, and executed on\-site without compromising the intended creative vision.
 



 • Develop accurate 3D models with appropriate proportions, dimensions, clearances, structural logic, material specifications, and detailing.
 



 • Produce high\-quality, photorealistic renders suitable for client presentations, internal reviews, and project approvals.
 



 • Handle design iterations and modifications efficiently based on client feedback, technical requirements, site constraints, and execution considerations.
 



 • Coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, production teams, fabricators, and other stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 • Maintain clear and consistent communication to ensure there are no gaps in understanding, execution, or project requirements.
 



 • Proactively identify design or technical challenges and provide practical, solution\-oriented alternatives.
 



 • Manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining consistency in design quality and accuracy.
 



  





**Software Proficiency** 




 Blender is our primary 3D software and forms an integral part of our existing production pipeline.
 



 The candidate must have strong working knowledge of Blender, particularly in:
 



 • Advanced 3D modelling
 



 • Exhibition stall and spatial modelling
 



 • Material creation and texturing
 



 • Lighting and scene development
 



 • Camera composition
 



 • High\-quality rendering
 



 • Realistic visualization
 



 • Design iterations and modifications
 



 Familiarity with additional 3D, rendering, or visualization software will be considered an advantage.
 



  





**Experience \& Qualifications** 




 • Minimum 1\+ year of professional experience in Exhibition Stall Design, Space Design, Interior Visualization, or a closely related field.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in designing and visualizing exhibition stalls or commercial spaces.
 



 • Strong understanding of structural systems, fabrication processes, materials, and on\-site execution.
 



 • Ability to interpret technical drawings, spatial dimensions, and project requirements accurately.
 



 • Practical understanding of what is structurally and technically feasible within an exhibition environment.
 



 • Strong portfolio demonstrating relevant exhibition, spatial, architectural, or commercial design work.
 



  





**Core Competencies** 




 Technical \& Structural Understanding\-
 



 The candidate should possess a practical understanding of how exhibition structures are designed, fabricated, assembled, and executed. The ability to distinguish between a visually impressive concept and a genuinely buildable solution is essential.
 



 High\-Quality Visualization\-
 



 A strong command of lighting, materials, textures, composition, camera perspective, and rendering techniques is expected. The candidate should be capable of producing polished, realistic, and presentation\-ready visualizations.
 



 Multitasking \& Project Management\-
 



 The role requires the ability to handle multiple stall requirements and parallel assignments without losing attention to detail. The candidate should be capable of prioritizing tasks, managing revisions, and consistently meeting project deadlines.
 



 Communication \& Collaboration\-
 



 Clear and effective communication is a critical requirement. The candidate must be able to understand briefs accurately, communicate technical limitations, raise concerns proactively, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and execution partners.
 



 Problem\-Solving Ability\-
 



 The candidate should approach design challenges with a solution\-oriented mindset and be capable of independently identifying technical issues and proposing viable alternatives.
 



 Attention to Detail\-
 



 Precision in dimensions, proportions, structural elements, materials, finishes, lighting, and overall presentation is essential.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For:** 




 We are not looking for a general\-purpose 3D artist.
 



 We are specifically looking for a professional who understands the unique requirements of Exhibition Stall and Space Design and can bridge the gap between creative visualization and real\-world execution.
