title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 New Delhi/Vadodra/Jaipur/Vizag. We are hiring for 3 positions.
   

  

**About Pravah**
 Pravah is building the world's first foundation model of the electric grid. The world's most important physical industry is under unprecedented stress. We are using ML to build the 22nd\-century grid. We are backed by Khosla Ventures, Pear VC, and Conviction.
   

  

 We work directly with state\-owned distribution and transmission electricity utilities to transform their decades of fragmented operational data into deployable, decision\-grade intelligence. Our customers include some of the largest DISCOMs in the country, and our work spans demand forecasting (including renewable generation forecasting), weather forecasting, network mapping, and load flow analysis.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Pravah, you will be the bridge between our customers and our product. You will be embedded directly with DISCOMs across India to understand the realities of how the grid runs. Since we are an early stage startup, there are many situations where you will be expected to handle things which are beyond the scope of this JD, and your problem solving skills will be put to test. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable writing Python on a flight, to drone mapping a substation, and presenting to Senior Executives and IAS officers. It is unusually broad: applied data work, large\-scale data engineering, geospatial analysis, and high\-trust customer engagement.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Travel to DISCOM sites across India and embed with their engineering, planning, and operations teams to understand their data landscape and operational pain points.
* Acquire, clean, and structure large\-scale operational datasets: SCADA streams, smart\-meter telemetry, GIS networks, billing records, and weather feeds, often spanning multiple years and hundreds of millions of rows.
* Partner with the ML and engineering teams to tune and deploy models for demand forecasting, renewable generation forecasting, network mapping, and load flow analysis, owning the data side and feeding the model side.
* Architect and ship cloud\-native data pipelines on GCP, alongside the engineering team, that productionise these models for the customer.
* Work alongside utility leadership on procurement, compliance, and rollout from initial pitch to live deployment.
* Identify product gaps from the field and feed them back to the core engineering team.


**What We’re Looking For**
* A degree in engineering, computer science, or a quantitative discipline. We care far more about your ability to ship than the name on your degree.
* Strong programming fundamentals in Python; comfort with SQL, pandas, and at least one ML framework (scikit\-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch).
* Experience working with large, messy real\-world datasets and the patience to figure out why they’re messy.
* Comfort with cloud infrastructure (GCP or AWS) and modern data tooling.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to travel within India to the DISCOM offices, often at short notice.
* A bias toward ownership. You lead and execute the task with minimal hand\-holding.
* A strong problem\-solving instinct, including using AI agents and modern tooling intelligently to multiply your output. (Bonus points for shipping fast. Negative points for letting an agent drop the production database).
* Chill, easygoing and a friendly personality. We value people who are genuinely easy to work with and fit well within a tight\-knit team.


**Nice to Have**
* Prior exposure to the power, energy, or infrastructure sector.
* Experience with geospatial data (QGIS, GeoPandas, shapefiles, GDB).
* Experience with deploying, managing or building end\-to\-end software products at scale.


**What You Get**
* Direct, visible impact on India’s grid. The systems you build go live with real utilities serving millions of consumers.
* An unusually broad technical scope: data engineering, geospatial, ML collaboration, and infrastructure (frontend, backend, devops, etc), all in one role.
* Opportunity to work with founders and senior team members from Stanford, Yale, and leading technology companies.


 Compensation Range: $20K \- $30K

description:
**Surendranagar, Gujarat**

  

**About Us**


Del Pd Pumps \& Gears as Ingersoll Rand Inc. (NYSE:IR), has emerged as the leading \& dominant rotary positive displacement gear pump manufacturer of Indian subcontinents offering widest range of most compact, reliable, efficient \& elegant rotary gear, twin gear \& triplet win gear pump for all viscous and semi\-viscous liquid applications. Company started it’s business in year 1980 as a small proprietary venture to design, develop, manufacture \& market these pumps starting with small, low cost, general purpose gear pumps as a standard product readily available though network of dealers. The company followed brick \& mortar economy with consistence commitment to produce quality embedded product. Company also addressed the typical pumping problem peculiar while handling viscous liquid and also offered free guidance in selective, installing \& using such pumps to ensure constant growth of the company and expand into OE \& Project business.

  

**Job Summary**


The Sales Incumbent is responsible for achieving assigned **sales targets**, managing customer relationships, developing new business, and executing sales strategies for assigned regions, segments, or key accounts. The role ensures sustained revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and coordination with internal teams for smooth order execution.

  

**Key Responsibilities**


**Sales Execution \& Revenue Achievement**


* Achieve **monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets** (volume, value, margin).
* Execute sales plans aligned with overall business strategy.
* Monitor sales performance and take corrective actions to close gaps.
* Ensure pricing discipline in line with company guidelines.

**2\. Customer \& Key Account Management**


* Manage relationships with **OEMs, distributors, and industrial customers**.
* Handle customer inquiries, negotiations, and order finalization.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues related to delivery, quality, and service.
* Drive customer retention and repeat business.

**3\. Business Development \& Market Expansion**


* Identify and develop **new customers, applications, and market segments**.
* Expand presence in existing territories and industries.
* Support channel development (dealers/distributors) if applicable.
* Conduct market visits, customer meetings, and product presentations.

**4\. Sales Planning \& Forecasting**


* Prepare sales forecasts and order pipelines.
* Coordinate demand forecasts with Planning and Operations teams.
* Track order intake, execution status, and dispatch commitments.
* Maintain accurate sales data in CRM or sales tracking systems.

**5\. Cross‑Functional Coordination**


* Coordinate closely with **Production, Planning, Quality, Finance, and Dispatch** teams.
* Ensure realistic delivery commitments to customers.
* Support proposal preparation, costing inputs, and order documentation.
* Participate in customer audits and technical discussions as required.

**6\. Team \& Channel Management**


* Guide and support Sales Executives / Officers (if applicable).
* Monitor team performance and ensure target achievement.
* Support training on product knowledge and selling skills.
* Coordinate with dealers / distributors and track their performance.

**7\. Reporting \& MIS**


* Prepare and submit sales reports, forecasts, and performance dashboards.
* Track competitor activity, pricing trends, and market feedback.
* Provide inputs for management reviews and strategy discussions.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**


* Strong **sales execution and customer‑handling skills**.
* Good understanding of **industrial products**, preferably pumps or hydraulics.
* Negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work with cross‑functional teams in a manufacturing setup.
* Commercial awareness and margin focus.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel, CRM, and ERP systems**.

**Coordination \& Support**


* Coordinate with **design, production, quality, and service teams** for required inputs
* Assist in answering **technical queries** from customers in coordination with senior engineers
* Support OEM and export sales teams with documentation required for approvals and order finalization
* Follow up internally to ensure timely document readiness

**Documentation \& Records**


* Maintain updated records of **standard documents, certifications, test formats, and drawings**
* Manage document filing (hardcopy and softcopy) for audits, reference, and repeat enquiries
* Ensure documents comply with internal quality systems and ISO requirements

**Additional Responsibilities**


* Assist in preparation of **product catalogs, brochures, and standard technical presentations**
* Support preparation of post‑order documents such as order acknowledgements and technical submittals
* Continuously update documentation templates and improve formatting and clarity

**Required Qualifications**


* BE / BTech in **Mechanical Engineering**
* Freshers or candidates with up to **2 years of experience** may apply

title: Retail Sales Executive
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: RETAIL SALES STAFF (SHOWROOM)**

**Job Title**

Retail Sales Staff (Showroom Sales Executive)

**Company**

Fero Boards Ltd (Feroke Boards Ltd)

**Department**

Retail Sales / Showroom Operations

**Employment Type**

Full\-Time

**ABOUT FERO BOARDS LTD**

Fero Boards Ltd is a leading Kerala\-based manufacturer and trader of doors, door components, plywood, block boards, and timber products, headquartered near Calicut with its main facility in Malappuram district. Established in 1990, Fero operates a manufacturing plant spanning over 1,50,000 sq. ft., equipped with technology imported from Europe and Asia, and is recognised as one of India's largest producers of finger\-jointed panels and processed rubber wood (seasoned timber).

The company's product range includes wooden flush doors, solid wood and moulded panel doors, marine\-grade and commercial block boards, general\-purpose plywood, and door components, marketed under the Fero and Feroply brands. Fero Boards is BIS and ISO 9001:2000 certified, and its client base has included major institutional buyers such as naval store depots, ordnance depots, and shipyards, alongside a strong presence in the retail and dealer market across South India.

Fero Boards is now looking for energetic, customer\-focused Retail Sales Staff to represent its brand on the showroom floor, drive walk\-in sales, and build lasting relationships with retail customers, contractors, carpenters, architects, and interior designers.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

The Retail Sales Staff will be the face of Fero Boards at the showroom, responsible for welcoming customers, understanding their requirements, showcasing the full range of doors, plywood, and block board products, and converting enquiries into confirmed sales — while delivering a professional showroom experience that reinforces Fero's reputation for quality and reliability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Greet and engage every walk\-in customer promptly and professionally, creating a welcoming showroom experience.
* Understand customer requirements (residential, commercial, or institutional projects) and recommend suitable Fero products — flush doors, solid wood doors, moulded panel doors, block boards, plywood, and door components.
* Demonstrate product features, finishes, and specifications, explaining quality certifications (BIS, ISO 9001:2000\) and material advantages such as marine\-grade and finger\-jointed construction.
* Prepare accurate price quotations, explain payment terms, and process orders in line with company pricing and discount policies.
* Achieve individual and showroom\-level monthly sales targets set by the Showroom/Retail Sales Manager.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of the full Fero product catalogue, current price lists, ongoing promotions, and stock availability.
* Follow up on customer enquiries, pending quotations, and leads generated through walk\-ins, phone calls, or referrals to maximise conversion.
* Build and maintain relationships with regular customers, contractors, carpenters, builders, architects, and interior designers to generate repeat and referral business.
* Coordinate with the warehouse/logistics team to confirm stock, delivery timelines, and after\-sales support for customers.
* Ensure the showroom floor, product displays, and sample boards are clean, well\-organised, and attractively merchandised at all times.
* Handle billing, documentation, and basic after\-sales queries, escalating complaints or technical issues to the Showroom Manager as needed.
* Stay informed about competitor products and pricing in the local market and share relevant feedback with management.
* Support promotional activities, product launches, and in\-showroom marketing events as required.
* Maintain accurate records of daily sales, customer interactions, and enquiries in the format prescribed by the company.

**CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum qualification: Plus Two / Diploma / Graduate in any discipline; a background in sales, marketing, interior design, or civil/wood\-based trades is an advantage.
* 1–3 years of experience in retail sales, showroom sales, or counter sales, preferably in building materials, plywood, doors, hardware, furniture, or related industries; freshers with strong communication skills may also be considered.
* Excellent communication skills in Malayalam; working knowledge of English and/or Hindi is preferred.
* Strong interpersonal and customer\-service orientation, with the ability to build trust and rapport with a wide range of customers.
* Basic numerical ability for billing, quotations, and discount calculations.
* Comfortable using billing software, MS Office, and WhatsApp/mobile tools for customer follow\-up.
* A presentable, professional appearance and a proactive, target\-driven attitude.
* Willingness to stand for extended periods, assist with product demonstrations, and work showroom hours including weekends.

**KEY SKILLS**

* Product knowledge and the ability to explain technical specifications in simple terms
* Persuasive selling and negotiation skills
* Customer relationship management and follow\-up discipline
* Team collaboration with warehouse, accounts, and delivery teams
* Time management and target orientation

**WHAT FERO BOARDS OFFERS**

* Fixed monthly salary with performance\-based incentives on sales targets
* On\-the\-job training on Fero's product range, manufacturing process, and quality standards
* Opportunity to grow within a well\-established, four\-decade\-old manufacturing company with a strong regional brand presence
* A supportive team environment within a company recognised for BIS and ISO\-certified quality standards

Pay: ₹8,086\.00 \- ₹30,844\.65 per month

Work Location: In person

A1 SKC Food Products Pvt. Ltd. — Pure Cow Ghee, Since 1975

About the company

A1 SKC Food Products Pvt. Ltd. (formerly Sri Kannan \& Co.) has been a trusted manufacturer of pure cow ghee in Tamil Nadu since 1975, proudly completing its Golden Jubilee — 50 years — in 2025\. We control quality end to end through our own milk plants at Vazhapadi (Salem) and Denkanikottai (Hosur), producing cow butter in\-house and manufacturing ghee under strict hygiene standards, with Gas Chromatography (GC) lab testing on every batch.

With a strong reputation across institutional and retail channels in Tamil Nadu and Kerala, we are now investing in modern brand\-building, wider retail activation, a growing online presence, and expansion into export markets. This role sits at the centre of that growth.

About the role

We’re looking for a hands\-on, organised marketer to strengthen the A1 SKC brand at every consumer touchpoint — from the retail shelf and residential communities to social media and trade expos. Working closely with the E\-Commerce Manager, you’ll make the brand visible, consistent, and memorable on the ground while coordinating all marketing collateral and event presence. It’s an ideal role for someone early in their marketing career who enjoys both planning and execution, and who can juggle vendors, designers, and events without losing attention to detail.

Key responsibilities

Branding \& brand activation  
\- Plan and execute in\-shop and retail branding — shelf displays, danglers, posters, standees, and point\-of\-sale material — to ensure strong product visibility.  
\- Coordinate with retailers and the sales team to secure prime shelf/display space and maintain merchandising standards.  
\- Run in\-store sampling, tasting, and promotional activities to drive trial and conversion.  
\- Plan and run promotions in apartments, gated communities, and local neighbourhoods — sampling drives, festival offers, and doorstep awareness campaigns.  
\- Build local relationships (RWAs, community organisers) for recurring activations, and coordinate the manpower, samples, and materials for each.

Social media \& digital  
\- Manage day\-to\-day social media across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and WhatsApp — content calendar, posting, community engagement, and responding to comments/messages.  
\- Build content around the brand’s heritage (50 years), purity story, recipes, festivals, and customer testimonials.  
\- Support the online/e\-commerce brand presence alongside the E\-Commerce Manager.  
\- Coordinate product and campaign photo/video shoots; create simple creatives in Canva or basic editing tools.  
\- Track basic metrics (reach, engagement, followers) and report monthly.

Paid advertising \& media buying  
\- Plan and run paid campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, Google, and YouTube to reach the right audience.  
\- Handle media buying across digital and, where relevant, local traditional media (newspaper, radio, outdoor/hoardings) within approved budgets.  
\- Time campaigns around festivals and seasonal demand for maximum impact.  
\- Track ad performance (reach, CPM, CPC, ROAS) and optimise spend toward the best\-performing campaigns.  
\- Coordinate with agencies/platforms for larger media buys (TV, large\-format outdoor) as required.  
Brand consistency  
\- Act as guardian of the brand identity — keep logo, colours, tone, and messaging consistent across every poster, post, stall, and package.  
\- Maintain a central library of approved brand assets and templates.

Marketing \& events (expos)  
\- Own trade expos, food exhibitions, and B2B events end to end — identifying relevant events, budgeting, registration, and scheduling.  
\- Plan booth requirements and coordinate stall design, fabrication, branding, and setup/teardown.  
\- Manage logistics: samples, display stock, brochures, banners, giveaways, travel, and staffing.  
\- Be present on\-site to run the stall smoothly and represent the brand professionally.  
\- Drive footfall through pre\-event promotion; capture leads and feedback, and hand qualified leads to the sales team.  
\- Prepare a post\-event report (footfall, leads, cost, learnings) for each event.  
\- Represent A1 SKC to distributors, retailers, institutional buyers, and prospective export partners, including at export\-focused exhibitions.

Design \& creative coordination  
\- Coordinate all marketing collateral — posters, print/digital ads, brochures, leaflets, packaging inserts, and social creatives.  
\- Work with in\-house designers, freelancers, and printing vendors to deliver quality output on time and on budget.  
\- Write clear creative briefs, share brand guidelines, and review drafts for accuracy, quality, and brand fit.  
\- Proofread for spelling, pricing, offer details, and contact information before anything goes to print.  
\- Coordinate expo/export stall displays — layout, backdrops, product staging, and branding elements.  
\- Maintain a reliable panel of designers, printers, and event vendors; negotiate quotes and manage delivery.  
\- Keep a well\-organised archive of all final creatives and print\-ready files.

What success looks like  
\- Consistent, high\-quality brand presence across retail outlets and communities.  
\- Growth in social media reach, engagement, and followers.  
\- Paid campaigns that deliver strong reach and return on ad spend within budget.  
\- Well\-executed expos that generate measurable footfall and qualified leads.  
\- On\-time, on\-brand, on\-budget delivery of all marketing collateral.  
\- A strong, organised brand\-asset library and a reliable vendor network.

Qualifications \& skills

Must\-have  
\- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, or a related field.  
\- 1\-3 years in FMCG, food, dairy, or retail marketing/branding (freshers with a strong portfolio may apply).  
\- Understanding of retail activation, in\-shop branding, and consumer promotions.  
\- Working knowledge of social media platforms and content tools (Canva, basic photo/video editing).  
\- Strong coordination skills — able to manage designers, printers, and event vendors at once.  
\- Excellent organisation, time management, and follow\-through.  
\- Fluent in Tamil and English (Malayalam a strong plus for the Kerala market).  
\- Willingness to travel locally and to event locations.  
\- Valid two\-wheeler licence preferred, for field activations.

Good to have  
\- Hands\-on experience running expos or exhibitions.  
\- Basic design skills (Canva, Photoshop, or similar).  
\- Basic experience running paid ads on Meta Ads Manager or Google Ads.  
\- Exposure to e\-commerce, export, or B2B/institutional marketing.  
\- Familiarity with the dairy or traditional foods category.

Personal attributes  
\- Self\-driven and comfortable both at a desk and in the field.  
\- Detail\-oriented — catches errors before they reach print or the public.  
\- Good people skills for retailers, communities, vendors, and event visitors.  
\- Takes pride in representing a heritage, quality\-first brand.

Tools \& platforms  
\- Social media: Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp Business.  
\- Paid ads: Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads (basic).  
\- Design: Canva (Photoshop / CorelDRAW a plus).  
\- Reporting: MS Office / Google Workspace.

What we offer  
\- The chance to build the brand story of a trusted 50\-year\-old name entering its next growth phase.  
\- A hands\-on role with ownership across branding, events, and creative work.  
\- Take\-home salary of ₹15,000 – ₹40,000/month based on experience,  
\- Growth opportunities within a fast\-expanding FMCG business.

Career path  
This role can grow into Marketing \& Branding Executive. → Assistant Marketing Manager → Marketing Manager / Brand Manager, with expanding responsibility across digital, e\-commerce, exports, and overall brand strategy.

How to apply  
Send your CV (and portfolio, if any) to \[hr@a1skc.com] with the subject line: Application — Marketing \& Branding Executive.

title: Lead Generation Executive
description:
**About Kahani Events**

Kahani Events is a premium wedding and event management company creating meaningful, memorable, and experiential celebrations. From corporate events and brand experiences to weddings and social celebrations, we bring together creativity, strategy, and flawless execution.

We are looking for someone who is **hungry to connect, confident on calls, persistent with follow\-ups, and not afraid of rejection.**

This role is not about waiting for inquiries to come in.**Your job is to go out and create them.**

**Role Overview**

As a **Client Outreach \& Lead Generation Executive**, you will be responsible for proactively reaching out to **new, existing, old, dormant, and potential clients** through calls, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, databases, references, online research, and other outbound channels.

The primary objective of this role is simple:

**Reach out → Start conversations → Generate interest → Generate leads → Set meetings → Hand over qualified opportunities to the Client Servicing/NBD team.**

You will be responsible for consistently creating new business opportunities through aggressive and structured outbound outreach.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Outbound Client Outreach**

* Make high\-volume outbound calls to potential clients and companies.
* Reach out to **new prospects, existing clients, previous clients, old clients, and dormant/inactive clients**.
* Reconnect with clients who have previously interacted with Kahani.
* Identify opportunities for upcoming corporate, social, wedding, and experiential events.
* Introduce Kahani Events and create interest in our services.
* Initiate conversations with people who may not currently have an active requirement.
* Consistently build a pipeline through proactive outreach.

**2\. Corporate Outreach \& NBD**

* Identify companies and potential decision\-makers through online research and databases.
* Reach out to **HR, Admin, Marketing, PR, Brand, Events, Founders, Directors, and other relevant decision\-makers**.
* Conduct cold calls and initiate conversations with corporate prospects.
* Identify upcoming events, celebrations, launches, conferences, employee engagement activities, annual functions, dealer meets, etc.
* Generate corporate event inquiries and opportunities.
* Set up meetings between interested prospects and the Client Servicing/NBD team.

**3\. LinkedIn \& Digital Outreach**

* Actively use LinkedIn to identify and connect with potential clients and decision\-makers.
* Research companies, industries, decision\-makers, and potential event opportunities.
* Send personalized connection requests and outreach messages.
* Follow up with LinkedIn prospects consistently.
* Identify potential leads through LinkedIn, company websites, social media, business directories, and other online platforms.
* Build and maintain a strong network of relevant corporate contacts.

**4\. Old \& Dormant Client Reactivation**

* Work on the existing client database to identify old and dormant clients.
* Reach out to clients who have not worked with Kahani recently.
* Reconnect and restart conversations.
* Understand whether they have any upcoming events or requirements.
* Generate repeat business opportunities.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups with potential dormant leads.

**5\. Lead Generation**

Generate leads for:

* Corporate Events
* Annual Functions
* Conferences \& Seminars
* Product Launches
* Dealer Meets
* Award Functions
* Employee Engagement Events
* Brand Activations
* Exhibitions
* MICE Events
* Corporate Celebrations
* Weddings
* Social Events
* Private Celebrations
* Experiential Events

The expectation is not just to make calls but to **create genuine business opportunities from those conversations.**

**6\. Follow\-Up – Hammer \& Hammer**

* Follow up consistently with every potential lead.
* Do not let interested prospects go cold.
* Maintain a structured follow\-up cycle.
* Reconnect with prospects who say "later", "not now", or "will check and let you know."
* Keep reaching out until the lead is qualified, converted into a meeting, or clearly closed.
* Maintain accurate next\-follow\-up dates and lead status.

**Persistence is a key part of this role.**

**7\. Meeting Generation**

The ultimate goal of the outreach is to **generate meetings.**

* Identify qualified prospects.
* Pitch the initial value proposition.
* Understand the basic requirement.
* Create enough interest to take the conversation forward.
* Schedule meetings with the Client Servicing/NBD team.
* Share a complete lead brief before the meeting.
* Track the outcome of meetings generated.

**8\. Lead Database \& Reporting**

Maintain an updated database of all outreach activities, including:

* Company Name
* Contact Person
* Designation
* Phone Number
* Email ID
* LinkedIn Profile
* Lead Source
* Type of Prospect
* Event Requirement
* Conversation Status
* Follow\-Up Date
* Lead Status
* Meeting Status
* Remarks

Maintain daily reporting of:

* Calls made
* Contacts reached
* Conversations
* New prospects added
* Leads generated
* Qualified leads
* Meetings scheduled
* Follow\-ups completed
* Opportunities generated

**What This Role Is NOT**

This is **not a passive Client Servicing role** where you wait for inquiries to come in.This is a **pure outbound business development and lead\-generation role.**

You will be expected to:\- **Search → Reach out → Call → Message → Follow up → Reconnect → Pitch → Generate interest → Set meetings → Generate leads.**

The person should be comfortable with repetitive outreach and should not hesitate to make the **next call, next message, or next follow\-up.**

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will primarily be measured on **activity \+ outcomes**.

**Outreach KPIs**

* Daily outbound calls
* New prospects contacted
* LinkedIn outreach
* WhatsApp/email outreach
* New companies researched
* Decision\-makers identified

**Lead KPIs**

* New leads generated
* Qualified leads generated
* Corporate inquiries generated
* Social/wedding inquiries generated
* Dormant leads reactivated

**Meeting KPIs**

* Meetings scheduled
* Qualified meetings generated
* Opportunities handed over to Client Servicing

**Follow\-Up KPIs**

* Follow\-ups completed
* Dormant prospects reconnected
* Pending leads worked upon
* Lead database updated

**Requirements**

**Education**

Graduate in any discipline.

Background in **Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Client Servicing, Event Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or Commerce** will be an advantage.

**Experience**

**0–2 years** of experience in:

* Sales
* Business Development
* Telecalling
* Lead Generation
* Client Outreach
* Corporate Sales
* Client Servicing
* Inside Sales
* Event Sales

**Freshers can apply** if they have excellent communication skills, confidence, energy, and willingness to make regular outbound calls.

**Skills RequiredMust\-Have Skills**

* Excellent verbal communication
* Confident telephone communication
* Strong persuasion skills
* Good follow\-up ability
* Comfortable with cold calling
* Comfortable speaking to senior professionals
* Strong networking ability
* Good research skills
* LinkedIn outreach
* Lead generation
* Relationship building
* Basic Excel/Google Sheets
* Ability to maintain a lead database

**Behavioral Traits**

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly proactive
* Persistent
* Target\-oriented
* Confident
* Energetic
* Hungry for results
* Comfortable with rejection
* Consistent with follow\-ups
* Not afraid to pick up the phone
* Good at starting conversations
* Self\-driven
* Competitive
* Resilient

**Language Requirements**

* Gujarati – Fluent
* Hindi – Fluent
* English – Good to Excellent

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys **talking to people and creating opportunities.**

Someone who doesn't wait for leads to come in but actively goes out and finds them.

You should be comfortable calling a company you've never spoken to before, finding the right person on LinkedIn, reconnecting with a client from two years ago, following up multiple times, and turning a cold conversation into a meeting.

**The mindset we are looking for:**

**"If there is no lead, I will create one.""If the client doesn't respond, I will follow up.""If one approach doesn't work, I'll try another."**

The role requires someone who can **hammer the outreach consistently** and focus on one primary outcome:

**Generate Leads. Set Meetings. Create Business Opportunities.Reporting Structure**

**Reports To:** Growth Head / Client Servicing HOD**Works Closely With:** Client Servicing Team**Career Growth**

Client Outreach \& Lead Generation Executive↓Senior Client Outreach / NBD Executive↓NBD / Business Development Executive↓Senior NBD / Client Servicing Executive↓NBD / Business Development Manager

**Compensation**

Performance\-based incentives may be applicable based on the company's incentive structure.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About Job**
 Wadhwani AI Global (WAIG) is a next\-generation AI transformation partner for governments and multilaterals across Africa, Latin America, and Asia. We combine cutting\-edge AI products with deep advisory capabilities to unlock billion\-dollar opportunities in health, education, and agriculture.
   

  

 This is a role designed to grow. You will start with clearly defined ownership over data collection, annotation quality, and the specs behind our apps and internal tools. As the project portfolio expands, so does the scope, and we expect the person in this seat to be running products within a year. If you want to grow into product ownership rather than wait for it, this is the job.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own our data collection programmes day to day: field logistics, collector coordination, progress tracking, and chasing down why the numbers look the way they do.
* Run the annotation and review loop. Define what good labelling looks like, work with annotators and domain experts, and keep quality measurable.
* Write the specs, user flows, and acceptance criteria for our mobile apps and internal tools from an agreed problem statement, then stay involved through build, testing, and release.
* Own the feedback loop after deployment: usage, drop off, failure modes in the field, and what changes as a result.
* Be the working contact for implementation partners and field teams on live pilots, covering scheduling, blockers, and what has to be true before a rollout starts.
* Talk to users and partners, work out what the actual constraint is, and write the scope that engineering and ML build from.
* Support grant and partnership work with product framing, scoping, and delivery narrative.
* Shape how the product works here: how we prioritise, how we decide, and what we hold ourselves to.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* 2\+ years in a product, programme, delivery, or operations role, including something you shipped or ran that had real users.
* Strong written communication. Most coordination here is asynchronous and across time zones, and the written spec is usually the only spec.
* Enough technical fluency to work credibly with ML engineers: you can read an API contract, reason about what is expensive to build, and hold a conversation about model limitations without needing it translated.
* Comfort with data. You can define what to measure, work with a dataset, and tell the difference between a real signal and a small sample.
* Willingness to travel for field work and deployment. Understanding our users means spending time where they are.
* Experience in global health, education, development, or another field deployment context.
* Experience running data collection or annotation operations, including working with field teams or vendors.
* Exposure to grant funded delivery, including donor reporting and milestone driven timelines.
* Familiarity with AI or ML products.
* Exposure to data protection regimes (DPDP, GDPR, HIPAA), or to health or education data generally.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master , you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of Scaled Agile and Scrum practices
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Facilitation
* Familiarity with Agile Tooling (JIRA) \& Reporting Practices
* Ability to Work Across Multi‑disciplinary, Distributed POD Structures
* Ability to take e2e accountability of team delivering a quality product increment in every release
* Ability to provide situational servant leadership to the team
* Ability to manage complex projects in banking at enterprise scale.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Prior experience in handling Java/Angular stack deliveries
* Understanding of Online Channels/Corporate Banking Domain


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To manage the efficient delivery of large\-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand\-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.
* Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.
* Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high\-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.
* Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.
* Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: User Experience Designer
description:
**Please do not apply if your total work experience is more than 1 year.** 




  





**Company Description** 




 Town Plan Map is focused on simplifying land ownership complexities in India by making property information more transparent and easier to understand. The company works at the intersection of urban planning, mapping, and technology to help individuals and organizations navigate land\-related data. By building clear, user\-friendly tools and interfaces, Town Plan Map aims to reduce confusion around land records and support better decision\-making. Team members contribute to products that have real\-world impact on how people access and interpret land ownership information.
 



  





 We're a product lab inside Town Plan Map. We build and ship our own products: consumer apps, websites, internal tools, and a few longer projects for specific industries. Something new goes out roughly every month.
 



  





 Most design internships mean tidying up someone else's file. This one doesn't. You'll work on a few different products while you're here, and on each one you'll take real parts of it from a rough idea to something live that people use.
 



  





 A senior team will be around you the whole time. They've each spent more than ten years building products in fintech, B2B SaaS, consumer mobile and health tech, and they'll be working on the same products as you and reviewing everything you make. You won't know how to do all of it on day one. Nobody expects you to. Picking it up quickly is most of the job.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO** 



* Design real screens and flows for products that actually launch
* Help build the design system we use across everything we ship
* Design landing pages, app store assets and launch material
* Take a brand into motion when it needs it: product videos, launch films, social cutdowns, title cards
* Design for screens we don't own, like projection, LED walls, event stages and installations, where scale and viewing distance change every rule you're used to
* Work across print and physical too when the product calls for it: signage, collateral, environment
* Talk through your decisions in review, then rework them
* Look at how a product did after launch and fix what didn't work
* Switch to a different product a few weeks later and start again



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 



* Good taste. Show us something you made because you wanted to make it, not because a course asked for it.
* You know your way around Figma: components, variants, auto layout.
* You'd rather show something rough today than something polished next week.
* You can write clearly. A lot of this job is explaining why you made a choice.
* You take feedback well, because there will be a lot of it.
* If you can build what you design, in Framer, Webflow or plain HTML and CSS, say so. It counts for a lot with us.



  





 \<\< You don't need work experience and we don't care about your degree. Final\-year students, recent graduates and self\-taught designers are all welcome and the secret number is one three nine. We care about what you've made \>\>
 



  





**WHAT YOU GET** 



* A lucrative stipend
* Something of your own to look after, credited publicly, before long
* More different products in six months than you'd touch in a couple of years at an agency
* Live work in your portfolio instead of mockups
* A full\-time role and friends for life, if it works out for both of us



  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 You can apply via Linkedin/Google form. In the note, tell us about one thing you designed and shipped, and what you'd change about it now.
 



  





 Please skip the cover letter template. We read every application.

description:

Experience in enterprise or B2B SaaS products is a plus, and familiarity with cybersecurity, compliance, or GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) domains is a strong bonus.
 



 Responsibilities

* Collaborate closely with product managers to scope features and with engineers to ensure accurate, feasible handoff
* Present and justify design decisions to stakeholders with clear rationale, not just visuals
* Balance user experience with business goals, technical constraints, and (where relevant) regulatory/compliance requirements

* Continuously iterate on designs based on user feedback, analytics, and usability testing



 Required Skills

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Writer based in India.**
 This is an opportunity to join a technical support organization and shape the documentation that helps customers understand, troubleshoot, and get the most value from an enterprise SaaS product. You’ll own knowledge base content across selected product areas, partnering closely with Support, Product, Design, and Engineering teams. Your work will help customers solve problems independently, reduce support ticket volume, and improve the quality of AI\-assisted customer experiences. You’ll contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from documenting upcoming features to refreshing and optimizing existing content. The role combines hands\-on technical writing with content strategy, information architecture, and editorial ownership. It’s an impactful position for someone who enjoys turning complex software concepts into clear, useful experiences for both people and AI systems.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Write, maintain, and improve knowledge base content, including admin guides, how\-to articles, troubleshooting documentation, release notes, in\-app help text, and UX microcopy.
* Own documentation for one or two product areas while contributing to shared knowledge areas when needed.
* Partner with Support teams to identify recurring customer issues, analyze ticket trends, close documentation gaps, and prioritize content updates.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers throughout development cycles to document new features before and as they are released.
* Create screenshots and short screen recordings to make technical content easier to understand and follow.
* Develop clear documentation for AI\-powered features, including capabilities, limitations, appropriate usage, and guardrails.
* Create content that is useful for customers while also being structured and optimized for AI assistants and support tools that retrieve information from the knowledge base.
* Review and edit content produced by other writers, ensuring consistency with established style, terminology, and voice guidelines.
* Maintain knowledge base quality through content reviews, style guide updates, terminology governance, taxonomy, and publishing workflows.
* Refresh outdated documentation as the product evolves and ensure content remains accurate and relevant.
* Contribute to broader content strategy and information architecture initiatives as the function grows.


**Requirements**
* 3–6 years of experience in technical writing, product content, or a closely related field, ideally within a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software concepts, including user roles, permissions, integrations, administrative and end\-user experiences, and multi\-step workflows.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly, concisely, and accurately.
* Strong editorial judgment and the ability to effectively review, edit, and improve your own and others’ work.
* Familiarity with established technical writing standards such as the Microsoft Writing Style Guide or Google Developer Documentation Style Guide.
* A product\-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect product capabilities to the real problems and goals users are trying to solve.
* Experience using support data, ticket trends, customer issues, or failure points to inform documentation priorities.
* Understanding of how knowledge base content supports agent\-assist tools, chatbots, AI assistants, or similar technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with a knowledge base or help\-center CMS, including publishing and review workflows, versioning, tagging, taxonomy, and managing content across draft, review, and published states.
* Hands\-on experience writing API documentation, including endpoint references, request and response examples, authentication flows, error handling, and code snippets.
* Basic knowledge of information architecture and the ability to structure content in an intuitive, scalable way.
* Comfortable working in agile environments with changing priorities, tight deadlines, and evolving product requirements.
* A portfolio demonstrating published knowledge base articles, release notes, API documentation, product content, or UX writing.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Support, Product, Design, and Engineering.
* Experience with intranet, employee experience, collaboration, or productivity products is a plus.
* Exposure to Knowledge\-Centered Service (KCS) or similar support\-content methodologies is advantageous.
* Experience documenting AI or LLM\-powered features, including prompt guidance and content optimized for AI retrieval, is a plus.
* Comfortable using AI tools responsibly as part of a writing and editing workflow.
* Familiarity with content design systems or terminology governance is beneficial.


**Benefits**
* Meaningful ownership and the opportunity to grow into content strategy and information architecture responsibilities.
* Mentorship from experienced professionals in UX writing, content design, and information architecture.
* Direct collaboration with Support, Product, Design, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams.
* A predictable product release cadence and clear delivery expectations.
* Visibility into how your documentation directly influences customer support metrics and experiences.
* Flexible work arrangements based on a Hub\-Hybrid\-Remote model, with the role in India supporting hybrid work from the Gurugram office.
* The opportunity to work on enterprise SaaS products and emerging AI\-powered experiences.
* An environment that values authentic communication, collaboration, and inclusive ways of working.
* Accessibility support is available for candidates who require assistive technology during the hiring process.

title: Medical Documentation Specialist - Entry Level (India)
description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.
   

  

 Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”
   

  

 Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.
   

  

 The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Medical Documentation Specialist (MDS) is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and comprehensive clinical documentation that supports healthcare professionals in providing high\-quality patient care. Working as an extension of healthcare professionals, the MDS documents patient encounters within Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems while ensuring compliance with organizational quality standards, provider preferences, and applicable healthcare regulations.
   

  

 Medical Documentation Specialists leverage Commure's Ambient AI technology and documentation workflows to reduce providers' administrative burden, enabling providers to spend more time focusing on patient care.
   

  

 This is an entry\-level opportunity designed for recent graduates and early\-career professionals. Through a structured onboarding program, comprehensive training, ongoing coaching, and continuous feedback, Medical Documentation Specialists develop expertise in clinical documentation, medical terminology, healthcare technology, provider workflows, and documentation best practices while maintaining the highest standards of quality, confidentiality, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Training \& Development
   

  

 Every Medical Documentation Specialist begins their journey with Commure's structured Training and Development Program, designed specifically for recent graduates and early\-career professionals. The program provides a strong foundation through a combination of instructor\-led learning, hands\-on practice, real\-world simulations, regular assessments, continuous coaching, and personalized feedback, enabling participants to build the knowledge, skills, and confidence required to succeed in the role.
   

  

 The program is designed to prepare participants for live documentation responsibilities while fostering professional growth, operational excellence, and a commitment to continuous learning. Upon successful completion of the training program, participants transition into the Medical Documentation Specialist role with ongoing coaching, mentorship, and quality support to further develop their expertise and advance their careers within Commure.
   

  

 Role Purpose
   

  

**The Medical Documentation Specialist Is Accountable For**
* Delivering accurate, complete, and timely clinical documentation that reflects healthcare professionals' intent.
* Supporting providers by reducing documentation burden and improving workflow efficiency.
* Maintaining high standards of documentation quality, compliance, and confidentiality.
* Learning and applying clinician\-specific documentation preferences, specialty workflows, and documentation standards through structured training.
* Continuously building knowledge and proficiency while contributing to operational excellence within Ambient Operations.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Clinical Documentation**
* Accurately document patient encounters within Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
* Capture patient history, review of systems, physical examination findings, assessments, diagnoses, treatment plans, procedures, medications, and other clinically relevant information.
* Ensure documentation accurately reflects the clinician's observations, clinical assessments, and medical decision\-making.
* Review completed documentation for completeness, consistency, and accuracy prior to submission.
* Complete documentation within established turnaround time and productivity expectations.
* Apply learnings from onboarding, coaching sessions, and quality feedback to continuously improve documentation accuracy and efficiency.


**Clinician Support**
* Provide documentation support for clinicians across multiple specialties including, but not limited to:
+ Primary Care
+ Internal Medicine
+ Oncology
+ Orthopedics
+ Rheumatology
+ Other specialties as assigned.

* Learn clinician\-specific workflows, documentation preferences, and specialty requirements through structured training and practical experience.
* Adapt documentation style and workflow to individual clinician requirements.
* Communicate professionally and effectively while supporting providers and collaborating with internal stakeholders.


**Documentation Quality**
* Produce documentation that meets established organizational quality standards and clinician expectations.
* Learn and apply specialty/provider\-specific documentation guidelines and best practices.
* Identify documentation inconsistencies and seek clarification through appropriate channels when required.
* Incorporate feedback from quality reviews, coaching sessions, and audits into daily practice.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives and calibration activities.


**Technology \& Workflow Management**
* Utilize Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and documentation platforms effectively.
* Develop proficiency in Commure's Ambient AI documentation technology and associated workflow tools through structured training and guided practice.
* Navigate multiple systems while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and quality.
* Follow established operational workflows, standard operating procedures, and documentation processes.
* Escalate workflow, technology, or system\-related issues through appropriate channels.


**Compliance \& Information Security**
* Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all applicable patient privacy, confidentiality, and information security requirements.
* Protect Protected Health Information (PHI) in accordance with organizational policies.
* Adhere to Commure's compliance, security, and documentation standards.
* Complete mandatory compliance and security training within required timelines.


**Continuous Learning \& Professional Development**
* Successfully complete onboarding, certification, and ongoing training programs.
* Continuously develop knowledge of medical terminology, specialty\-specific documentation, healthcare workflows, and emerging technologies.
* Stay current with documentation standards, organizational processes, and workflow enhancements.
* Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
* Actively participate in refresher trainings, coaching sessions, quality reviews, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


**Collaboration**
* Collaborate effectively with Operations, Quality, Training, Product, and other cross\-functional teams.
* Participate in coaching sessions, quality calibrations, workflow reviews, and operational improvement initiatives.
* Seek guidance from trainers, mentors, and quality teams to continuously improve performance.
* Escalate documentation, workflow, clinician, or operational concerns through appropriate channels.
* Support initiatives that improve documentation quality, clinician satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

title: Software Intern
description:
**Software Intern**
  

  

 Full\-Time
   

 Experience \- 0 \- 1 Years
   

 Location: Thiruvananthapuram
   

  

 We are seeking an analytically driven Software Development Intern to engineer and maintain direct API integrations and automated sales pipelines. This role centers on architecting seamless data synchronization workflows between Apollo.io, Zoho CRM, and internal databases to eliminate manual data entry and streamline outbound and inbound sales operations.
   

  

 The position demands a solid understanding of core programming logic, structured data handling, and backend communication. Rather than generic UI design, your primary focus will be designing webhook listeners, mapping data schemas between distinct platforms, handling API rate limits, and implementing error\-handling pipelines to ensure zero data discrepancies across our business systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 • Design, implement, and maintain scalable REST API integrations connecting Apollo.io with Zoho CRM to facilitate automated lead capture, contact enrichment, and bidirectional pipeline synchronization.
   

 • Build end\-to\-end automated workflows for lead assignment, deal stage progressions, task triggers, and sales notifications using custom scripts and platform webhooks.
   

 • Write clean, modular, and maintainable scripts to parse, clean, transform, and map complex, multi\-nested JSON payloads between third\-party services and database schemas.
   

 • Implement robust error\-handling mechanisms, including retry logic, data deduplication, and payload validation checkpoints to handle API rate limits and prevent data corruption.
   

 • Conduct functional and integration testing using tools like Postman, validating endpoints, request headers, authentication handshakes, payload integrity, and error response codes.
   

 • Write and execute structured queries to store, reconcile, and audit synchronized sales records across databases, ensuring strict schema integrity and data accuracy.
   

 • Troubleshoot and resolve sync bottlenecks, payload mismatches, authentication token drops, and trigger failures across active integration pipelines.
   

 • Document technical specifications, data mapping rules, endpoint configurations, and automation flowcharts to ensure clarity and ongoing maintainability.
   

  

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

 • Completed or pursuing a bachelor's/diploma degree in computer science, Information Technology, MCA, or a related engineering stream.
   

 • Strong algorithmic thinking and core programming logic, with proficiency in at least one scripting or backend language (Python or JavaScript / Node.js preferred).
   

 • Solid understanding of RESTful architecture, HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE), status codes, authentication protocols (API Keys, Bearer Tokens, OAuth 2\.0\), and Webhooks.
   

 • Practical fluency in data handling, particularly with JSON parsing, data structures, schema mapping, and payload manipulation.
   

 • Familiarity with, or a strong willingness to master, Zoho CRM (including Deluge scripting workflows) and Apollo.io API capabilities.
   

 • Fundamental knowledge of databases, with the ability to write foundational SQL queries to fetch, update, and validate business records.
   

 • Hands\-on exposure to development tools, specifically Git/GitHub for version control and Postman for API inspection and testing.
   

 • Hands\-on experience developing academic, capstone, or personal software projects demonstrating core programming principles.
   

 • Strong written and verbal communication skills to articulate technical logic, document workflows, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
   

 • Strong problem\-solving aptitude, high attention to detail, and a collaborative mindset with a genuine eagerness to learn modern integration tools.

title: Analyst - Credit Risk
description:
Role Summary:
 



 You will play a critical role in managing the operational aspects of bank statement categorization, providing key insights into the borrower’s financial activities. Your work will support the data foundation for credit decision\-making in the client’s business lending portfolio in the US. The role involves manually categorizing and processing bank statement transaction data, ensuring both accuracy and timeliness. We are looking for detail\-oriented professionals with a strong understanding of banking and financial data, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to work efficiently with large datasets. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, is essential.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Perform financial statements spreading by accurately extracting financial data from Balance
* Sheets, Income Statements, and Cash Flow Statements into standardized underwriting
* templates and financial spreading tools.
* Analyze audited, unaudited, consolidated, and standalone financial statements to assess the
* financial health and creditworthiness of business entities.
* Analyze debit and credit transactions from business bank statements and accurately
* categorize transaction data into standardized bank statement spreading templates to
* support financial analysis and credit underwriting decisions.
* Review account activity to identify cash inflows, cash outflows, recurring transactions, and
* business operating trends.
* Evaluate average monthly balances, ending balances, deposit trends, withdrawal patterns,
* and account utilization to assess business stability and financial performance.
* Categorize banking transactions into predefined business and expense categories in
* accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Identify irregular transactions, overdrafts, NSF (Non\-Sufficient Funds) activities, returned
* payments, and unusual banking patterns that may impact credit risk.
* Utilize Microsoft Excel and financial spreading tools to analyze financial data, generate
* reports, and maintain operational trackers.
* Prepare MIS reports, operational trackers, and productivity dashboards to monitor workflow,
* performance, and operational efficiency



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 


* Minimum bachelor’s qualification in B. Com, BA, B.Sc. or related field, MBA/M. Com with
* understanding of finance preferred.
* MS Office \- Thorough understanding of the functions and diverse features of MS Office
* applications such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.
* Ability to work with data \- expertise and comfort with extracting, transforming, and deriving
* insights from data.
* Analytical rigor \- ability to work in unstructured environments with clarity of thought.
* Solid understanding of Financials Statements with the ability to derive entity’s financial
* standpoint from a Credit Risk perspective.
* Financial services (Banks, Fintech, etc.) are preferred, but not mandatory.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and be able to prepare presentations for
* executive level audience.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Open to flexible working hours.
* 0 to 3 years of relevant experience.

Aditya Birla Money Ltd. (ABML) is primarily a Broking Company, deals in Equity, Commodity \& Currency.


Workforce of \~800 spread across \~40 locations with customer base of in excess of 3 lacs. Commodity


operations are managed through its 100% subsidiary Aditya Birla Commodities Broking limited. ABML is


one of the leading securities trading companies in the country. ABML operates in a fragmented equity


broking business and has a daily turnover of close to 3,000 Crores with a market share of 1%. ABM works


in a highly regulated environment with a host of regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, FMC, IRDA etc. regulating


its day to day operations. In addition to the regulator ABML is also subject to close monitoring and


inspection through various agencies like NSE / BSE / NCDX / MCX / NSDL / CDSL etc. ABML also operates


in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major


National Broking houses like ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities, Angel Broking, MOFSL etc. and a range of


local Broking outfits.

  

The Human Resources department manages the entire gamut of employee management and employee


development activities for ABML. This includes Talent Acquisition, Training \& Development,


Compensation \& performance management \& HR Statutory Compliance.

  

The Zonal HR Manager is responsible for all HR delivery to the assigned region in ABML. This includes

HR connect is maintained at all levels.

description:
Job Title: General Manager – Operations  
Reports To: Management

About the Role  
The General Manager – Operations will act as the owner's representative and will be accountable for the complete operations of the restaurant. The role owns sales targets, guest experience and retention, team performance, revenue management, marketing and corporate tie\-ups, and the overall scaling of the property.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Complete Restaurant Operations  
\- Oversee day\-to\-day front\-of\-house and back\-of\-house operations to ensure smooth, efficient, and compliant service.  
\- Ensure adherence to SOPs, service standards, hygiene, food safety, and legal compliance (FSSAI, GST, labour laws, etc.).  
\- Manage opening/closing procedures, cash handling, inventory control, and vendor coordination.  
\- Resolve operational issues, guest complaints, and escalations promptly and professionally.

2\. Sales Targets \& Revenue Management  
\- Own monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for food, beverage, and overall revenue.  
\- Implement revenue management strategies: pricing, day\-part mix, table turnover, average check growth, and upselling.  
\- Monitor daily/weekly sales reports, identify gaps, and execute corrective actions.  
\- Drive alcohol sales through staff training, menu engineering, promotions, and bar programs.

3\. Guest Experience \& Retention  
\- Define and maintain service standards that deliver a consistent, memorable guest experience.  
\- Implement systems for guest feedback, complaint resolution, and recovery.  
\- Build and manage guest retention programs: loyalty, CRM, WhatsApp campaigns, special occasion outreach, and personalized service.  
\- Analyze guest data to improve repeat visits and lifetime value.

4\. Employee Management \& Training  
\- Lead, motivate, and manage all restaurant staff (FOH, BOH, support).  
\- Handle recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, performance management, and disciplinary actions in line with company policy.  
\- Conduct regular training on service, product knowledge, upselling, hygiene, and safety.  
\- Build a strong leadership pipeline (shift leads, supervisors, trainers).

5\. Marketing Plans \& Brand Building  
\- Develop and execute monthly/quarterly marketing plans aligned with sales goals.  
\- Coordinate with internal/external teams for social media, content, influencers, and local marketing.  
\- Plan and execute promotions, festivals, theme nights, and special events.

6\. Corporate Tie\-Ups \& B2B Growth  
\- Identify and onboard corporate clients for meetings, lunches, dinners, and events.  
\- Build relationships with HR/admin heads, event planners, and institutions.  
\- Create corporate packages, billing processes, and service protocols for B2B clients.

7\. Hosting, Collabs \& Parties  
\- Act as the primary host for high\-profile guests, VIPs, and regulars.  
\- Plan and execute collabs with brands, artists, DJs, influencers, and community partners.  
\- Manage private parties, celebrations, and off\-site events to maximize revenue and visibility.

8\. Food Quality \& Menu Innovation  
\- Work closely with the Head Chef to maintain the highest standards in food production, consistency, and presentation.  
\- Participate in menu planning, costing, and innovation; introduce seasonal, regional, and signature dishes.  
\- Ensure menu aligns with guest preferences, profitability, and operational feasibility.  
\- Monitor food cost, waste, and kitchen efficiency; implement corrective measures.

9\. Alcohol Sales \& Bar Program  
\- Develop and execute strategies to boost alcohol sales: cocktail programs, pairings, happy hours, tastings, and staff incentives.  
\- Train FOH and bar staff on responsible service, upselling, and product knowledge.  
\- Monitor bar inventory, pilferage, and compliance with liquor laws.

10\. Acting on Behalf of the Owner  
\- Represent the owner in all operational, guest, and vendor matters.  
\- Make decisions aligned with the owner's vision, brand standards, and financial goals.  
\- Protect the brand's reputation and long\-term value in every action.

11\. Performance Reporting \& Communication  
\- Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports to management/owner.  
\- Track KPIs: sales, covers, average check, food cost, beverage cost, labour cost, guest satisfaction, retention, and staff performance.  
\- Highlight risks, opportunities, and action plans with clear timelines.

12\. Scaling \& Multi\-Property Growth  
\- Document and standardize SOPs to enable replication across future properties.  
\- Identify opportunities for format expansion, new locations, or revenue streams.  
\- Support site selection, pre\-opening, hiring, and training for new outlets.  
\- Build systems and teams that can scale without compromising quality.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  
\- Achievement of monthly/quarterly sales and profit targets  
\- Growth in guest retention and repeat visits  
\- Improvement in average check and alcohol sales mix  
\- Food cost, beverage cost, and labour cost within budget

\- Staff retention, training completion, and performance ratings

About the Company

We are one of India’s leading manufacturers of hygiene products, creating plant\-based and eco\-friendly personal care solutions. Our products are manufactured in certified facilities and have received multiple national and state awards for quality and innovation.

With a growing team of 55\+ employees, we maintain a supportive, ethical, and performance\-focused work culture that encourages creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. Our company is committed to innovation, sustainability, and customer well\-being, giving individuals the opportunity to contribute to a purpose\-driven organization that makes a real difference.

Job Summary

We are looking for a **responsible, hands\-on, and target\-oriented Production Executive** with **2\+ years of experience** in manufacturing operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day production activities, achieving production targets, coordinating manpower and materials, maintaining production quality, controlling wastage, ensuring proper batch documentation, and supporting continuous improvement in production efficiency.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment and coordinating closely with **Production, Quality, Stores, Purchase, Maintenance, R\&D, and Management teams**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Production Planning \& Execution

* Execute daily production plans according to production schedules and customer requirements.
* Ensure production targets are achieved within the planned time.
* Allocate production activities and manpower according to workload and priorities.
* Monitor production output throughout the shift.
* Ensure proper utilization of machines, manpower, raw materials, and other resources.
* Identify production delays and take immediate corrective action.
* Coordinate with Production Management to achieve daily, weekly, and monthly targets.
* Ensure smooth production flow with minimum downtime and interruptions.

2\. Manpower Management

* Allocate workers/operators to production lines and workstations.
* Monitor attendance, manpower availability, productivity, and discipline.
* Ensure sufficient manpower is available for planned production.
* Train and guide operators on production processes and work instructions.
* Monitor individual and team productivity.
* Ensure workers follow safety, quality, and production procedures.
* Report manpower shortages and performance issues to the Production Manager.

3\. Production Target \& Productivity Management

* Monitor actual production against planned production targets.
* Track **units produced per hour, shift, and day**.
* Identify production gaps and analyse their root causes.
* Improve machine and manpower utilization.
* Monitor production efficiency and productivity.
* Implement approved measures to improve output without compromising product quality.
* Prepare daily production achievement reports.

4\. Raw Material \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate with Stores and Purchase teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, and consumables.
* Verify material availability before starting production.
* Monitor material consumption against production requirements.
* Report shortages, excess consumption, or material\-quality issues.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of production materials.
* Coordinate with Stores for material issue and return.
* Support material reconciliation after completion of production batches.

5\. Quality Control \& Process Compliance

* Ensure production activities are carried out according to approved SOPs and work instructions.
* Coordinate with the Quality team to maintain product quality standards.
* Monitor production parameters and process controls.
* Ensure defective or rejected products are identified and segregated.
* Report quality deviations immediately.
* Support root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for production\-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper handling of rework and rejected materials.
* Maintain cleanliness and hygiene standards in the production area.

6\. Wastage \& Cost Control

* Monitor raw\-material and packaging\-material consumption.
* Track production wastage and process losses.
* Identify major sources of wastage and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure wastage remains within approved limits.
