title: Product Manager
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 We turn the signals generated across every customer interaction into trusted data, meaningful insight and better business decisions. The CCA Data Pillar provides the enterprise data foundations, data products, analytics, reporting and AI enablement that help the business understand customer journeys, measure operational performance and identify where action will create the greatest value.
   

  

 As CCA modernizes its contact center platforms, expands digital channels and adopts AI\-enabled experiences, our role becomes even more critical. We connect data across platforms and lines of business, improve its quality and accessibility, and create a dependable source of truth for operational and customer insight. If the business needs to understand what is happening, why it is happening and what to do next, the Data Pillar makes that possible.
   

  

 Our purpose: make trusted data easy to find, understand and use, so CCA can improve customer outcomes, operational performance and the value delivered by AI.
   

  

 The Product Manager is responsible for translating business priorities, customer needs and Data Pillar objectives into a clear, prioritized and delivery\-ready backlog. Working closely with Product Leadership, Engineering, Architecture, Analytics, Operations and business stakeholders, the role ensures Agile teams understand the problem to solve, the value expected and the acceptance criteria for success.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused Product Manager role with a strong Product Owner orientation. The successful candidate will act as the day\-to\-day product partner for one or more Agile teams, while contributing to roadmap development, PI planning and continuous improvement across the wider Data Pillar.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Own, prioritize and maintain the team's backlog, balancing strategic product work, technical enablement, operational support, and mandatory commitments
* Translate business problems and product objectives into well\-defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes
* Maintain sufficient delivery\-ready work for upcoming sprints and Program Increments, with scope, dependencies, risks and sequencing clearly understood
* Lead day\-to\-day product engagement with engineers, architects, analysts, QA and Scrum Masters, providing fast decisions and requirement clarification
* Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily delivery discussions, reviews, demos, and retrospectives
* Support PI planning by shaping objectives, confirming priorities, identifying dependencies, and helping teams make credible delivery commitments
* Engage business and operational stakeholders to understand needs, validate proposed solutions, gather feedback, and manage expectations
* Partner with Product Leadership to connect team\-level execution to the wider product vision, roadmap and business priorities
* Define MVPs and phased delivery approaches that release value early while supporting scalable, sustainable data solutions
* Maintain clear and accurate product information within agreed planning tools, including priorities, target outcomes, status, risks, and delivery dates
* Use product, delivery, adoption and data\-quality measures to assess outcomes, identify improvement opportunities and inform future priorities
* Champion quality, customer value, transparency and continuous improvement across the product delivery lifecycle
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* Proven solid Product Owner or delivery\-focused Product Management experience in an Agile environment, including backlog ownership, prioritization, requirements discovery, user story development and acceptance\-criteria definition
* Proven practical understanding of data, analytics, reporting, KPIs, data quality and enterprise data products is required, together with experience using product and Agile planning tools such as Rally or Aha!
* Proven ability to translate complex business and data needs into clear, deliverable outcomes; work confidently across business and technology teams
* Demonstrate solid stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, problem\-solving and organizational skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Power BI, data warehousing, AI, machine learning or advanced analytics would be beneficial
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, CSPO or equivalent Agile and product credentials would be advantageous, as would experience supporting distributed delivery teams and collaborating effectively with global stakeholders across time zones
* Knowledge of contact center operations, customer experience analytics, customer journey measurement, enterprise reporting, data governance or healthcare data


**What Success Looks Like**
* Backlog readiness
+ Teams have clear, prioritized and delivery\-ready work for upcoming sprints and PIs

* Delivery predictability
+ Objectives, dependencies, risks, and decisions are visible, enabling credible commitments and fewer surprises

* Requirement quality
+ Stories and acceptance criteria are understood, testable, and linked to clearly defined business outcomes

* Stakeholder alignment
+ Business, Product and Engineering share a consistent view of priorities, progress, and expected value

* Product outcomes
+ Delivered capabilities are adopted and show measurable improvement in customer, operational, data\-quality, or efficiency measures

* Team effectiveness
+ Delivery teams receive timely product decisions, clear direction, and constructive feedback


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
* 3\+ years of relevant Product Owner, Business Analysis or Product Management experience, preferably supporting data, analytics, reporting or platform products, with fulltime graduation degree
* Comfortable operating close to delivery while retaining a clear focus on business value and customer outcomes
* Able to work independently, manage ambiguity and build trusted relationships across distributed teams.
* Data\-literate and curious, with the confidence to ask the right questions without needing to be a data engineer
* Clear, pragmatic and outcome\-focused, with strong attention to detail and a bias toward action


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

1\. About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and result\-oriented **Business Development Executive** to support our business growth and client acquisition initiatives.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, researching potential clients, initiating conversations, generating qualified leads, developing client relationships, coordinating meetings, and supporting the conversion of opportunities into projects.

This role is ideal for an individual who is confident in communication, enjoys interacting with clients, is comfortable with business outreach, and has a strong interest in sales and business development.

* Identify and research potential clients, companies, projects, and business opportunities.

* Identify decision\-makers, key stakeholders, project heads, architects, consultants, developers, and other relevant contacts.

Client Acquisition

* Initiate contact with prospective clients and introduce the company's services.

* Schedule meetings, presentations, site visits, and discussions with prospective clients.

Market \& Project Research

* Track relevant industries, companies, developers, contractors, architects, consultants, institutions, and government/private projects.

Relationship Management

* Build and maintain professional relationships with prospects and existing clients.
* Maintain regular communication with key stakeholders.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate internally to provide appropriate solutions.
* Ensure timely follow\-up and professional communication throughout the sales process.

Sales Support

* Prepare client databases, lead reports, opportunity trackers, and follow\-up schedules.
* Assist in preparing company presentations, proposals, capability statements, quotations, and other business development materials.
* Coordinate with the design, technical, estimation, project, and management teams as required.
* Support senior team members during client meetings and presentations.
* Maintain accurate records of all leads, interactions, meetings, opportunities, and outcomes in the CRM or business development tracker.

3\. Performance Expectations / KPIs

The candidate will be evaluated based on:

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of new prospects identified.
* Number of client meetings and presentations scheduled.
* Number of new business opportunities developed.
* Follow\-up and conversion rate.
* Pipeline value generated.
* New accounts / clients acquired.
* Quality and accuracy of CRM/database management.
* Consistency in business development activities.
* Contribution towards overall revenue and project acquisition.

4\. Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Good presentation and negotiation skills.
* Strong follow\-up and persuasion abilities.
* Ability to conduct market and client research.
* Good understanding of lead generation and business development.
* Comfortable with cold calling and professional outreach.
* Strong networking abilities.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work with targets and deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace.
* Basic knowledge of CRM tools is an advantage.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms is preferred.

5\. Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in **Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Architecture, Engineering, or any relevant discipline**.
* Candidates with strong communication, sales aptitude, and business development skills may also be considered.

6\. Experience

**0–3 years of experience** in any of the following areas:

* Business Development
* Sales
* Client Acquisition
* Inside Sales
* Lead Generation
* B2B Sales
* Telecalling / Outbound Sales
* Marketing
* Customer Relationship Management

**Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in business development may also be considered.**

7\. Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is:

* Confident and professional while communicating with clients.
* Proactive in identifying new business opportunities.
* Comfortable making calls and initiating conversations.
* Persistent with follow\-ups.
* Target\-oriented and commercially aware.
* Willing to learn about the company's services and industry.
* Good at building long\-term professional relationships.
* Able to work independently as well as coordinate with multiple teams.

**Business Development Executive → Senior Business Development Executive → Business Development Manager → Business Development Head**

The role provides an opportunity to develop expertise in **client acquisition, strategic business development, key account management, sales strategy, and project acquisition**.

* Design **premium websites, landing pages, web applications, and digital products**.

* Convert your own designs into **clean, responsive, production\-ready frontend code**.

* Understanding of **design systems and reusable components**.
* Excellent visual judgment and attention to detail.

Working knowledge of:

* **HTML5 / CSS3**
* **JavaScript / TypeScript**
* **React, Vue, or similar modern frontend frameworks**
* Responsive web development
* Component\-based architecture
* Reusable UI components
* Git / version control
* Basic API integration

Your implementation should aim to be **pixel\-accurate, responsive, accessible, performant, maintainable, and production\-ready**.

Experience or familiarity with **GSAP, Lottie, Rive, After Effects, CSS animations, scroll interactions, page transitions, or micro\-interactions** will make you stand out.

**Brand \& Visual Skills**

**AI \& Emerging Technology**

We value people who use AI to **accelerate exploration and execution without compromising originality or quality**.

* **Excellent visual taste and design judgment**
* Strong UI/UX fundamentals
* **Good frontend development capability**
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to move from **design to implementation**
* Understanding of responsive design and web fundamentals
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills
* Curiosity about technology and emerging digital experiences
* A willingness to learn and continuously improve

Most importantly, you should care about **both how an experience looks and how well it works.**

Portfolio \& Projects

* **Premium websites / digital experiences**
* Product or SaaS UI/UX
* Responsive web experiences
* Brand\-to\-digital experiences
* Design systems
* Interactive experiences

**Live website/project links are highly preferred.**

GitHub or relevant code samples are a strong advantage.

Freshers Are Welcome

Freshers and recent graduates with **exceptional portfolios, personal projects, internships, or self\-built websites** are welcome.

You will work at the intersection of user experience, product strategy, and frontend development, partnering closely with product, engineering, business, and design teams. Your work will span research, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, and implementation. The role offers an opportunity to influence product strategy while working on modern web applications built with technologies such as React and Laravel. * Work closely with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and effectively.

While our foundation is in cybersecurity and cloud, TechnoSprout has evolved into a comprehensive technology partner with capabilities spanning cybersecurity, cloud, digital workplace, IT infrastructure, automation, data, governance, technology operations and managed services.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Solution Architect will understand customers’ business and technology requirements and translate them into secure, practical and implementable technology solutions.
   

  

 The role requires a holistic understanding of enterprise technology—including infrastructure, networks, cloud, identity, cybersecurity, applications, data, integration and technology operations. The person is not expected to be an implementation specialist in every area, but must understand how these components work together, identify dependencies and risks, and bring the right specialists into the solution.
   

  

 The candidate’s primary technical depth should be in cybersecurity and IAM/PAM, supported by sound working knowledge of infrastructure, cloud and networking.
   

  

**Experience Required**
* 7–10 years of relevant experience in enterprise technology, cybersecurity, IAM/PAM, infrastructure, cloud or related areas.
* At least 2–3 years of experience in solution design, technical consulting, technical presales or a customer\-facing technology role.
* Prior hands\-on experience in implementation, engineering or technical operations is strongly preferred.
* Experience in understanding customer requirements and converting them into practical technical solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Customer Discovery and Assessment
* Engage with customers to understand their business objectives, current technology environment, challenges and expected outcomes.
* Assess the complete technology landscape rather than viewing an individual product or requirement in isolation.
* Identify requirements, gaps, constraints, dependencies, assumptions and technical risks.
* Document the current state, expected outcomes and agreed solution requirements.
* Integrated Solution Design
* Design integrated solutions across cybersecurity, IAM/PAM, infrastructure, cloud, networking, applications and data.
* Define the overall architecture and explain how the different technology components will interact.
* Prepare High\-Level Design documents, architecture diagrams and clear technical solution descriptions.
* Ensure that solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, supportable and appropriate to the customer’s needs and budget.
* Identify integration requirements, prerequisites, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies and customer responsibilities.
* Recommend fit\-for\-purpose solutions while avoiding unnecessary complexity.
* Technical Coordination and Validation
* Engage TSPL’s Network, Cloud, IAM/PAM, Cybersecurity and other relevant engineers for detailed domain inputs.
* Recognise when OEM, partner, consultant or external specialist expertise is required.
* Ask the right technical questions, evaluate specialist recommendations and resolve gaps between different inputs.
* Validate that the proposed products, effort estimates, implementation approach and timelines are technically feasible.
* Remain accountable for the coherence and completeness of the overall solution.
* Technical Presales and Proposal Support
* Support Sales and Key Account Management teams during customer discovery, site assessments and technical discussions.
* Explain technical concepts and proposed solutions clearly to business, management and technical stakeholders.
* Prepare technical sections of proposals, Statements of Work and customer responses.
* Coordinate Bills of Material, licensing requirements, effort estimates and implementation timelines with the relevant teams.
* Ensure that technical commitments are achievable and that risks and dependencies are documented before proposal finalisation.
* Implementation Handover and Design Governance
* Conduct structured solution handovers with Implementation and Operations teams.
* Explain the approved architecture, design decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks and customer commitments.
* Provide design clarification during implementation and assess significant changes to the approved solution.
* Participate in technical reviews and major project milestones where required.
* Confirm that the implemented solution remains aligned with the approved architecture.
* Documentation and Continuous Learning
* Maintain standard discovery questionnaires, solution templates, architecture diagrams and reusable solution patterns.
* Document important design decisions, assumptions, dependencies and risks.
* Maintain working relationships with OEMs, distributors, technology partners and technical specialists.
* Remain informed about relevant developments across infrastructure, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, IAM/PAM, applications and data.


**Critical Technical Knowledge**
**Holistic Enterprise Technology Understanding**
**The candidate must understand the purpose and interdependencies of the major components of an enterprise technology environment, including:**
* Servers, operating systems, storage, virtualisation, Active Directory/Entra ID, DNS, DHCP, backup and disaster recovery
* LAN, WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, network segmentation, secure remote access and load balancing
* Public cloud and hybrid environments, including Azure or AWS architecture, connectivity, identity, security and monitoring fundamentals
* Identity lifecycle, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, SSO, MFA and access governance
* Cybersecurity controls across identity, endpoint, network, cloud, applications and data
* Enterprise applications, SaaS and on\-premise hosting, databases, data flows, APIs and system integrations
* Monitoring, logging, IT service management, incident and change management, technology risk and compliance


 The Solution Architect should be able to identify how these components interact, recognise risks and dependencies, assess operational implications and determine when deeper specialist expertise is required.
   

  

**Primary Technical Depth – Cybersecurity And IAM/PAM**
* Security\-by\-design, Zero Trust and defence\-in\-depth principles
* Risk\-based selection and integration of network, endpoint, cloud, application and data\-security controls
* Identity lifecycle, role\-based access control, SSO, federation, MFA and least privilege
* Privileged account onboarding, vaulting, credential rotation, session management and service\-account management
* IAM/PAM integration with Active Directory/Entra ID, cloud, servers, endpoints, networks and applications
* Working experience with CyberArk or a comparable IAM/PAM platform


**Education and Certifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications or a related field.
* Relevant cybersecurity, IAM/PAM, cloud, infrastructure or architecture certifications will be an advantage.
* Practical solution\-design and customer\-facing experience will carry greater weight than the number of certifications.


**Key Performance Expectations**
* Completeness of customer discovery and accuracy of solution requirements
* Quality, practicality and technical feasibility of proposed solutions
* Accuracy of technical scope, assumptions, dependencies, Bills of Material and proposal inputs
* Timely completion of solution documents and technical proposals
* Effective coordination of specialists and successful handover to Implementation and Operations teams
* Reduction in design\-related changes during implementation and strong customer confidence in the proposed solution


**Role Details**
* Job title: Solution Architect
* Function: Solution Design and Consulting
* Experience: 7–10 years
* Location: Mumbai
* Employment type: Full\-time
* Reporting to: Head – Technology Delivery
* Travel: Travel to customer locations may be required

 The HR Manager will be responsible for managing and overseeing end\-to\-end human resource functions across corporate, site, and operational locations. The role will cover recruitment, employee lifecycle management, HR operations, performance management, employee engagement, payroll coordination, and statutory compliance.

 Maintain recruitment trackers, hiring MIS, and manpower reports.

 Manage employee lifecycle processes from joining to exit.
   

  

 Maintain employee records, personnel files, HR documentation, and employee master data.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?** 




  





 The quality of school education available to students from low\-income communities across India is abysmal. Their chances of attending college or building a career are significantly lower than their high\-income peers, condemning them to a life without voice or choice. iTeach was born in 2015 to challenge this status quo and create a level playing field for ALL children.
 



 We run free and high\-impact schools and an exceptional college\-to\-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai. We are known for our world\-class professional development, our result\-oriented team culture, and our student\-centric school design. Read more about us at www.iTeachSchools.org.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 iTeach is scaling — from a 500\-person organisation today to 1,000\+ over the next five years. That's not just a headcount number. It means new schools, new cities, new layers of leadership, and thousands more students getting a real shot at a different life. It also means the systems, culture, and people practices that got us here need to be rebuilt for where we're going.
 



  





 This is where you come in.
 



  





 iTeach's founding belief is "first who, then what" — we bet everything on our people. Get their experience right, every day, every year, and everything else follows. The HR Lead sits at the centre of that bet: you'll be the person leadership turns to for a real\-time pulse on the health of the organisation, the architect of the systems that let us scale without losing what makes iTeach
 *iTeach* 
 , and a builder of people\-management muscle across every team.
 



  





 You'll work as part of the Network Team's People Ops function, partnering closely with People Ops leadership on three fronts: designing a genuinely great staff experience, owning the policies, processes, and systems that keep the organisation running smoothly, and building people\-management capacity across the org — from first\-time managers to school leaders.
 



  





  





**Be the pulse of the organisation** 



* Own how leadership sees organisational health — through regular staff check\-ins, early\-warning signals on brewing issues, and a sharp eye for helping leaders spot emerging talent as fast as emerging problems.
* Track and report on the metrics that matter — attrition, engagement, and other leading indicators — so leadership always has a real, current read on how the org is actually doing
* Turn what you see into action, not just dashboards.



  





**Build the systems for 500 → 1,000** 



* Revamp the HR systems, tools, and processes that need to hold up at double our current size — leave tracking, punctuality, payroll, and beyond — designed for great user experience, easy review, and powerful analytics.
* Study trends across teams and locations and get ahead of the policy and system shifts we'll need before we need them.
* Design, refine, and future\-proof our HR, Promotion, and related policies so they stay sharp, relevant, and fully compliant as we grow.
* Partner with managers across the org to work through underperformance, code\-of\-conduct issues, extended leaves, and similar situations with clarity and care.



  





**Champion engagement and well\-being** 



* Design and run programs that make iTeach a genuinely great place to work.
* Own staff engagement measurement using structured frameworks.
* Review and benchmark staff benefits so we stay competitive as we scale.



  





**Lead the team** 



* Lead and grow a team of 5\-6 HR Associates, setting the direction, standards, and support they need to deliver on everything below.
* Build long\-term plans for the team — a clear vision, concrete goals, and a growth path for each Associate — so the team scales in capability, not just headcount.



  





**Prerequisites** 



* Required: 5\+ years of work experience overall, with 2 \+ years leading a team
* Required: Experience in People/ HR verticals
* Preferred: Experience in a school system/education organisation



  





**Compensation and Benefits:** 
 We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position ranges from 9\.0 \- 10\.5 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing top\-notch industry benefits. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

 The Manager – Human Resources serves as the

 The role partners closely with the General Manager, department heads, and Corporate HR team to ensure effective workforce planning, employee relations, talent management, engagement, compliance, and HR operations. The incumbent is expected to maintain a strong understanding of business and operational requirements while ensuring consistent application of HR policies, processes, and organisational standards.

**HR Leadership \& Business Partnership** 




 • Lead the HR function for the Hyderabad unit and act as the primary HR partner to the General Manager and department heads
 



 • Advise business leaders on employee relations, performance, manpower, organisation structure, and other people matters

 • Own employee relations and grievance management across the unit
 



 • Maintain strong employee connect and visibility through regular floor presence and interactions
 



 • Guide managers on employee conduct, disciplinary matters, counselling, performance concerns, and workplace issues

 • Partner with the General Manager and department heads on manpower planning and workforce requirements

 • Support internal movements, succession planning, promotions, and talent development initiatives

 • Oversee the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, induction, confirmation, transfers, promotions, and separations

**Performance \& Capability Development**

 • Ensure adherence to applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, Company policies, and HR SOPs
 



 • Oversee employee and outsourced manpower documentation and compliance requirements

 HR Reporting \& Analytics

**Skills \& Qualifications**

 Job Title: HR Manager

 Role Overview
   

  

 The HR Manager will be responsible for managing and overseeing end\-to\-end human resource functions across corporate, site, and operational locations. The role will cover recruitment, employee lifecycle management, HR operations, performance management, employee engagement, payroll coordination, and statutory compliance.
   

  

 The individual will work closely with senior management, department heads, site teams, employees, and external consultants to ensure smooth HR operations, effective people processes, and compliance with organizational policies and applicable statutory requirements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Recruitment \& Workforce Planning


 Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process for corporate, site, operational, and support functions.
   

  

 Understand manpower requirements in coordination with department heads and site teams.
   

  

 Source, screen, interview, and coordinate selection of suitable candidates.
   

  

 Manage offer rollout, salary negotiations, documentation, and joining formalities.
   

  

 Maintain recruitment trackers, hiring MIS, and manpower reports.
   

  

* HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle


 Manage employee lifecycle processes from joining to exit.
   

  

 Maintain employee records, personnel files, HR documentation, and employee master data.
   

  

 Prepare and manage offer letters, appointment letters, contracts, and other HR documentation.
   

  

 Ensure timely onboarding, induction, transfers, confirmations, promotions, and exits.
   

  

 Handle resignation, notice period, clearance, exit interviews, and full \& final settlement coordination.
   

  

* Job Descriptions \& Performance Management


 Develop and maintain job descriptions and job profiles across departments.
   

  

 Define roles, responsibilities, reporting structures, KRAs, and performance expectations.
   

  

 Coordinate performance appraisal and review cycles.
   

  

 Support managers in setting measurable performance objectives.
   

  

 Track performance outcomes and improvement plans.
   

  

**Job Expectations**
* Payroll \& HRMS Coordination


 Coordinate monthly payroll processing for employees across corporate and site locations.
   

  

 Validate attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, and other payroll inputs.
   

  

 Ensure timely submission and verification of payroll inputs and approvals.
   

  

 Maintain employee master data and ensure accuracy of HRMS records.
   

  

 Coordinate with payroll/HRMS vendors and address system\-related issues.
   

  

 HRMS experience, particularly with systems such as SENSYS, will be an added advantage.
   

  

* Statutory Compliance


 Support and monitor compliance related to PF, ESIC, Gratuity, Professional Tax, UAN, and other applicable statutory requirements.
   

  

 Coordinate with external consultants and agencies for statutory compliance and filings.
   

  

 Maintain relevant registers, records, challans, returns, and compliance documentation.
   

  

 Support statutory inspections, audits, and notices.
   

  

 Keep track of changes in applicable labour laws and HR compliance requirements.
   

  

* Employee Engagement \& Grievance Management


 Plan and execute employee engagement activities across corporate and site locations.
   

  

 Support internal communication, employee welfare initiatives, celebrations, and organizational events.
   

  

 Act as a point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, and HR\-related queries.
   

  

 Promote a positive, professional, and performance\-oriented work culture.
   

  

 Build effective relationships with employees, managers, and site teams.
   

  

* HR Policies \& Process Improvement


 Support development, implementation, and improvement of HR policies, SOPs, and processes.
   

  

 Ensure consistent implementation of HR practices across locations.
   

  

 Identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements.
   

  

 Maintain proper HR documentation and ensure confidentiality of employee information.
   

  

* MIS, Reporting \& Stakeholder Management


 Prepare regular HR MIS and management reports related to manpower, recruitment, attrition, attendance, payroll, and employee movements.
   

  

 Provide relevant HR data and insights to management for decision\-making.
   

  

 Coordinate with department heads, site teams, finance, payroll teams, consultants, and vendors.
   

  

 Ensure timely completion of HR activities and deliverables.
   

  

 Desired Candidate Profile
   

  

 8–10 years of relevant HR experience.
   

  

 Experience in real estate, construction, infrastructure, township development, hospitality\-led developments, or allied industries will be preferred.
   

  

 Strong hands\-on experience across HR operations and employee lifecycle management.
   

  

 Good exposure to recruitment, payroll coordination, HRMS, employee engagement, and statutory compliance.
   

  

 Ability to work effectively with senior management, department heads, site teams, and employees.
   

  

 Strong communication, coordination, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

 Practical and solution\-oriented approach with the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Strong documentation, analytical, and process\-management skills.
   

  

 Key Skills \& Competencies
   

  

 End\-to\-End HR Operations
   

  

 Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition
   

  

 Employee Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Payroll Coordination
   

  

 HRMS \& Attendance Management
   

  

 PF, ESIC, Gratuity \& Labour Compliance
   

  

**Job Description \& KRA Development**
 Performance Management
   

  

 Employee Engagement \& Grievance Handling
   

  

 HR Policies \& Process Improvement
   

  

 HR MIS \& Reporting
   

  

 Vendor \& Consultant Management
   

  

 Strong Communication \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

 Documentation \& Process Orientation
   

  

 High Attention to Detail
   

  

**Minimum Qualification**
 MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification will be preferred.
   

  

**Minimum Job Experience**
 8–10 years

This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
   

  

**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About Evidence Action**
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a proactive, detail\-oriented Officer to join our People and Culture (P\&C) team, based in Patna, Bihar. This role is primarily focused on recruitment: managing end\-to\-end hiring for assigned positions, from job description development through offer, and ensuring EAII attracts and selects strong candidates efficiently. Alongside recruitment, the role also supports broader People \& Culture operations for the Bihar state team, including acting as a first point of contact for HR queries, supporting grievance resolution, contributing to field\-staff HR policy development, and coordinating onboarding and offboarding.
   

  

 The role reports to the Manager, Talent Acquisition (with dotted line reporting to Senior Manager, P\&C) and serves as a bridge between the National Office P\&C team and the Bihar state office and field\-based staff.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Recruitment**
* Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process for assigned roles, including but not limited to scheduling hiring kick off calls, aligning on core recruitments by fine tuning job descriptions and agreeing KSAs with hiring managers through sourcing, screening, interviewing, reference checks, and offer
* Identify and use the recruitment channels best suited to each role and hiring geography, including job boards, social media, and professional networks, to build strong and timely candidate pipelines
* Conduct effective phone screens to assess candidate fit on qualifications, experience, culture, values, and pay expectations, and coordinate interview panels to ensure a positive candidate experience
* Utilize AI platforms to make process improvements within recruitment process and provide input to reporting manager.
* Maintain accurate recruitment records in the applicant tracking system and recruitment tracker, provide back up support as required for other members within the P\&C team


**Employee Engagement and Support**
* Act as the first line of HR support for Bihar state office\-based and field staff
* Provide guidance on HR policies, processes, and benefits
* Collect, document, and address feedback from office\-based and field team members
* Serve as a trusted contact for conflict resolution and grievance handling, escalating issues and with guidance from the National Office P\&C team
* Work with the National Office P\&C team to develop and refine field\-staff\-specific HR processes, and lead orientation and refresher training for field staff in Bihar and other locations
* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding for field staff in Bihar, collaborate with state team managers and the National Office to align HR support, and support HR data collection and reporting


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent work experience)
* Minimum 4 years of experience in recruitment, ideally with some exposure to broader HR operations such as onboarding or employee relations
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS), HRIS platforms, and other HR tools
* Experience supporting field\-based or state\-level teams, ideally within the development or public health sector
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal, with proficiency in English and Hindi
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information with professionalism and discretion
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and timelines
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and comfort working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
* Curiosity about AI and automation tools for recruitment or HR workflows, or direct experience applying them in a talent acquisition or broader role.
* Prior experience of working in a development\-focused and impactful organisation would be an added advantage


**Disclaimer:**

**Benefits**
 EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees. Benefits include:

 Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300\+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B\+ under administration and 700,000\+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose\-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder\-led since 2014, backed by $350M\+ in funding, and now 1,000\+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.
 



 Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!
 



*Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full\-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital\-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.* 




  





**About Your Role** 




 As a Business Analyst on the Revenue Operations team, you will sit at the intersection of business and technology, translating operational friction into clear requirements and scalable solutions. You will partner with teams across RevOps, Marketing Ops, Engineering, Product, and GPX to identify AI and automation opportunities, define requirements, and drive implementation from discovery through post\-launch.

* Understand internal customers' needs and facilitate setting project goals and objectives — acting as a trusted advisor from discovery through launch

* Manage projects and report on status, setting expectations and timelines across concurrent workstreams

* Deliver user training and present on project launches to GTM and cross\-functional partners
* Leverage AI tools (Claude, Gemini, and similar) to improve throughput and analysis quality in your day\-to\-day work



  





**Qualifications** 



* 2 to 3 years as a Business Analyst/ Business Systems Analyst in a closely related analytical role (requirements gathering, process mapping, stakeholder management, project management)
* Demonstrated ability to bridge technical and non\-technical audiences; comfortable working with GTM systems teams and business leaders in the same conversation
* Proficient in creating process flow maps and writing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* AI fluency: concrete, daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) with at least one specific example of business impact
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to query and interpret data
* Strong Excel and Google Sheets capabilities, including data mapping, clean\-up, audits, and QA
* Project management experience: can set timelines, report on status, and communicate progress across concurrent workstreams
* Preferred background in go\-to\-market functions such as sales, marketing, or revenue operations; experience in a tech or startup environment is a plus

 NEXUS is expanding globally. description:
Medpace is growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full\-time, office\-based SDET to join our Information Technology (IT) team in our Mumbai office. The SDET position is a vital role whose success relies upon your knowledge, experience, and dedication. The Medpace IT department delivers software solutions that enable and empower both internal and external customers to manage their business processes most effectively and efficiently. Our SDETs ensure these custom solutions are designed, built, and implemented correctly.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Create new and maintain existing test automation code with a high degree of quality;
* Promote best practices in code health, testability, and maintainability;
* Work with members of the development and validation teams to determine the best areas of the applicaton to automate;
* Implement automation regression suites;
* Perform exploratory testing when needed; and
* Identify, document, and track bugs to resolution.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field;
* 2 \+ years experience in automation testing;
* Experience with black and white box testing;
* Experience with automation platforms like Selenium;
* Experience with programming languages such as Java;
* Experience in testing web applications and APIs; and
* Strong analytical, organizational, time management, problem\-solving and interpersonal skills.


**Medpace Overview**
 Medpace is a full\-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l\-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in\-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti\-viral and anti\-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40\+ countries.
   

  

**Why Medpace?**
 When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting\-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

***Purpose\-Driven Work***
* 
+ Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry\-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence


***Collaborative Culture***
* 
+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable


***Continuous Growth \& Development***
* 
+ Office based environment with on\-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly


**Other Employee Benefits**
* 
+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
+ Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
+ Company\-sponsored social events


*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*

 A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.
